Compilation and Revision Academy has no other circumstances: "Compilation and Revision Academy" refers to the Hanlin Academy, where literary officials served. Here, it says the Hanlin Academy has no record of Li Yi's appointment, providing an excuse to send him to the frontier.

敕书付他星夜前往："敕书"指皇帝下达的诏令，"星夜前往"指连夜赶路，强调催促李益尽快赴任，不给停留机会。
Edict given to him, proceed by starlight: "Edict" means an imperial decree; "proceed by starlight" means traveling overnight, emphasizing urging Li Yi to assume his post quickly, giving no chance to linger.

无毒不丈夫：俗语，指心不狠便成不了大事，此处卢太尉以俗语自况，显其心狠手辣。
No poison, no true man: A saying meaning one cannot achieve great things without ruthlessness. Here, Grand Marshal Lu uses the saying to describe himself, showing his vicious .

鹊语新晴："鹊语"指喜鹊鸣叫，传统认为鹊鸣是喜兆，"新晴"指雨后初晴，此处以鹊语新晴烘托喜悦氛围。
Magpies speak, newly clear: "Magpies speak" means magpies calling; traditionally considered an auspicious omen; "newly clear" means just cleared after rain. Here, magpies and clear weather enhance the joyful atmosphere.

上苑闻莺："上苑"指皇家园林，"闻莺"为春日常见意象，常与喜庆关联，此处暗合科举中第的喜悦。
Upper Park hear orioles: "Upper Park" refers to the imperial gardens; "hear orioles" is a common spring image, often associated with celebration. Here, it subtly matches the joy of exam success.

云近蓬莱，烟消洛浦："蓬莱"代指皇宫，"洛浦"源自洛神典故，此处写云雾近皇宫、洛浦烟消，营造清朗喜庆的场景。
Clouds near Penglai, mist vanishes at Luo Riverbank: "Penglai" represents the imperial palace; "Luo Riverbank" originates from the Goddess of the Luo story. Here, clouds near the palace and vanishing mist at the riverbank create a clear, celebratory scene.

荀令语俜停："荀令"指荀彧，相传他身有香气，"俜停"指姿态优美，此处以"旧香荀令"喻指李生的风采与香气。
Xun Ling's words, graceful and poised: "Xun Ling" refers to Xun Yu, said to have a natural fragrance; "graceful and poised" means elegant posture. Here, "old fragrant Xun Ling" metaphorically refers to Scholar Li's elegant demeanour and aura.

游画省："画省"指尚书省，代指官场，"游画省"指在官场任职，此处为梦中场景。
Wander the Painted Province: "Painted Province" refers to the Department of State Affairs, representing officialdom. "Wander the Painted Province" means serving in officialdom. Here, it is a dream scene.

入彀英雄：源自唐太宗"天下英雄入吾彀中矣"，指科举中第的贤才，此处赞李生是入彀的英雄。
Enter the net hero: Originates from Emperor Taizong of Tang's "All under heaven's heroes enter my net," referring to worthy talents who passed the exams. Here, it praises Scholar Li as a hero who entered the net.

旧相如有驷马前言：源自司马相如富贵后驾驷马高车回乡的典故，此处盼李生如相如般功成名就。
Old Xiangru had four-horse former words: Originates from the story of Sima Xiangru returning home in a four-horse high carriage after achieving wealth and honor. Here, it hopes Scholar Li will achieve success and fame like Xiangru.

新京兆稳画眉清兴："京兆画眉"源自张敞为妻画眉典故，指夫妻恩爱，此处祝愿婚后恩爱如初。
New Capital Governor steadily paints eyebrows, pure delight: "Capital Governor paints eyebrows" originates from Zhang Chang's eyebrow-painting story, meaning conjugal affection. Here, it wishes the couple to be as affectionate after marriage as before.

跳龙门：源自"鲤鱼跳龙门"典故，比喻科举登第，此处指李生中状元如跳过龙门。
Jump the Dragon Gate: Originates from the "carp jumps the Dragon Gate"story, metaphorically meaning passing the imperial exams. Here, it means Scholar Li becoming the top graduate is like jumping the Dragon Gate.

除书亲得凤衔来："除书"指任命文书，"凤衔"指文书如凤凰衔来，形容任命尊贵，源自古代"凤衔书"的祥瑞传说。
Appointment document personally obtained, phoenix carries it: "Appointment document" means the document of appointment; "phoenix carries it" means the document is as if carried by a phoenix, describing the appointment as honour. Originates from the auspicious legend of "phoenix carrying a book."

绿衣郎近得红妆敬："绿衣郎"指新科进士，因穿绿袍而称，"红妆"指新娘，此处写新科进士与新娘的喜庆相见。
Green-robed lad recently obtains red attire's respect: "Green-robed lad" refers to a new and successful candidate in the highest imperial examinations , so called because they wore green robes; "red attire" refers to the bride. Here, it writes of the joyful meeting of the new and successful candidate in the highest imperial examinations and the bride.

天街上游衍把香风趁："天街"指京城街道，新科进士常游街夸官，"香风趁"形容游街时的风光与香气。
Heavenly Street above, wandering and strolling, take advantage of the fragrant breeze: "Heavenly Street" refers to the capital's streets; new and successful candidate in the highest imperial examinations often paraded through the streets to show off their official status; "take advantage of the fragrant breeze" describes the glory and fragrance during the parade.

合欢树今端正："合欢树"象征夫妻和睦，此处以合欢树端正喻指夫妻姻缘美满。
Union happiness tree now upright: "Union happiness tree" symbolizes conjugal harmony. Here, the tree being upright metaphorically means the couple's marriage is blissful.

游昼锦："昼锦"指富贵还乡，源自"衣锦昼行"，形容科举中第后荣归的荣耀。
Wander in daytime brocade: "Daytime brocade" means returning home in glory and wealth,from"wearing brocade and traveling by day." It describes the glory of returning home after exam success.

绿暗红稀出凤城："凤城"指京城，"绿暗红稀"指春尽，此处暗指即将离开京城赴边关，隐含离别愁绪。
Green dark, red sparse, leave Phoenix City: "Phoenix City" refers to the capital; "green dark, red sparse" means spring is ending. Here, it subtly means soon leaving the capital for the frontier, implying parting sorrow.

秦箫彻："秦箫"源自萧史弄玉吹箫引凤的典故，代指夫妻间的欢爱之音，"秦箫彻"指欢爱之声将尽，暗喻离别。
Qin flute ends: "Qin flute" originates from the Xiao Shi and Nongyu story, representing the sounds of conjugal joy. "Qin flute ends" means the sounds of joy are ending, subtly metaphorizing parting.

阳关叠：即《阳关三叠》，是著名的离别乐曲，此处"好门楣作了阳关叠"指原本喜庆的家门因离别变得如《阳关三叠》般伤感。
Yang Pass repeats: i.e., "Parting at Yang Pass Three Times," a famous farewell song. Here, "fine door lintel becomes Yang Pass repeats" means the originally celebratory household becomes sorrowful like the song due to parting.

鸳鸯三十六，孤鸾还一只："鸳鸯"象征夫妻和睦，"孤鸾"喻指独居的女子，此处以鸳鸯分离、孤鸾独存形容离别后的孤寂。
Thirty-six mandarin ducks, one lone simurgh remains: "Mandarin ducks" symbolize conjugal harmony; "lone simurgh" metaphorically refers to a solitary woman. Here, the separation of ducks and the lone simurgh describe the loneliness after parting.

合欢衾，连心枕："合欢衾"指绣有合欢图案的被子，"连心枕"指象征心意相通的枕头，均为新婚用品，此处反衬离别之苦。
Union happiness quilt, connecting hearts pillow: "Union happiness quilt" refers to a quilt embroidered with union happiness patterns; "connecting hearts pillow" means a pillow symbolizing connected hearts. Both are nuptial items. Here, they contrast with the pain of separation.

七香车：古代贵族妇女所乘的华丽车辆，此处"站不了七香车"指丈夫离去，不再有车马相伴的温馨。
Seven-incense carriage: A magnificent carriage ridden by noblewomen in ancient times. Here, "cannot stand in the seven-incense carriage" means the husband is gone, no longer the warmth of carriage and horses.

旗影里把笔阵扫龙蛇："笔阵扫龙蛇"形容文才出众，此处指李生到边关后需在军阵中发挥文才，草拟文书。
Within banner shadows, sweep the writing formation, dragons and snakes: "Sweep the writing formation, dragons and snakes" describes outstanding literary talent. Here, it means after arriving at the frontier, Scholar Li must use his literary talent in the army ranks, drafting documents.

雌雄剑：相传干将莫邪铸雌雄双剑，常象征夫妻或伴侣，"雌雄剑花偷觑"以剑的分离暗喻夫妻离别。
Male and female swords: Legend says Ganjiang and Moye forged a pair of male and female swords, often symbolizing husband and wife or companions. "Male and female sword flowers steal a glance" uses the separation of the swords to metaphorize the couple's parting.

江左参军，洛阳才子："江左参军"指赴任的官职，"洛阳才子"指李生的才名，此处点明身份与去向。
River Left Army Consultant, Luoyang talented scholar: "River Left Army Consultant" refers to the position he is going to assume; "Luoyang talented scholar" refers to Scholar Li's reputation for talent. Here, it clarifies his status and destination.

凤将雏："凤将雏"指鸾凤育雏，象征家庭和睦、子女绕膝，此处生自愧未能陪伴家人。
Phoenix tending fledglings: Means the phoenix caring for its young, symbolizing family harmony and children around the knees. Here, the young scholar feels ashamed for not being able to accompany his family.

瑶池西母，把绛桃深护："瑶池西母"即西王母，传说其有不死之药和绛桃，此处为生祝愿岳母如西王母般安康长寿。
Jade Pond Western Mother, deeply protects the crimson peaches: "Jade Pond Western Mother" is the Queen Mother of the West, said to have the elixir of immortality and crimson peaches. Here, the young scholar wishes his mother-in-law health and longevity like the Queen Mother.

桐花凤：鸟名，常栖息于桐花上，象征夫妻相伴，"覆不着桐花凤"指夫妻分离，无法再相守。
Tung flower phoenix: A bird name, often perched on tung flowers, symbolizing the couple together. "Cannot cover the tung flower phoenix" means the couple is separated, unable to be together anymore.

桂树乌："乌"指乌鸦，常与凄凉氛围关联，"子母空啼桂树乌"形容母女因离别而空自悲啼。
Cassia tree crow: "Crow" refers to a crow, often associated with desolate atmospheres. "Mother and child vainly cry, cassia tree crow" describes the mother and daughter vainly weeping due to the separation.

鹏程路：源自"鹏程万里"，比喻前程远大，此处指李生赴边的仕途之路。
Roc's journey road: Originates from "roc's journey of ten thousand li," metaphorically meaning a vast future. Here, it refers to Scholar Li's official path to the frontier.

儒冠误：源自杜甫"儒冠多误身"，指读书人因功名而受困，此处鲍四娘感叹功名误人离别。
Confucian hat mistake: Originates from Du Fu's "Confucian hat often mistakes the person," meaning scholars suffer due to fame and rank. Here, Bao Siniang laments that fame and rank mistake people into separation.

慈闱冷，好温存你个凤女孤："慈闱"指母亲的居所，"凤女孤"指女儿孤寂，生嘱托老夫人照顾好孤单的女儿。
Compassionate chambers cold, kindly warm your lonely phoenix daughter: "Compassionate chambers" refers to the mother's residence; "lonely phoenix daughter" means the lonely daughter. The young scholar entrusts the old lady to take good care of the lonely daughter.

化龙躯："化龙"比喻前程远大，如鱼化龙，此处老夫人祝愿李生在边关保重身体，前程顺利。
Transform into dragon body: "Transform into dragon" metaphorically means a vast future, like a fish transforming into a dragon. Here, the old lady wishes Scholar Li to take care of his health at the frontier and have a smooth future.

长亭语："长亭"为古代送别之地，"长亭语"指离别时的话语，形容离别时的不舍与叮咛。
Long Pavilion words: "Long Pavilion" was a place for farewells in ancient times. "Long Pavilion words" refers to the words spoken at parting, describing the reluctance and admonitions during farewell.

阳关曲：即《阳关三叠》，著名的离别乐曲，因王维"劝君更尽一杯酒，西出阳关无故人"而闻名，此处"怕奏阳关曲"表达对离别的畏惧。
Yang Pass tune: i.e., "Parting at Yang Pass Three Times," a famous farewell song, renowned for Wang Wei's line: "I urge you to drink one more cup of wine; West of Yang Pass you'll find no old friends." Here, "fear playing the Yang Pass tune" expresses fear of parting.

灞陵桥，阳关路："灞陵桥"为古代长安送别之地，"阳关路"指通往西域的边关之路，均为离别意象，烘托送别氛围。
Baling Bridge, Yang Pass road: "Baling Bridge" was a farewell place near Chang'an; "Yang Pass road" refers to the road to the Western Regions frontier pass. Both are parting images, enhancing the farewell atmosphere.

江干桃叶凌波渡："桃叶渡"为传说中王献之送爱妾桃叶的渡口，代指送别之地，此处以江干桃叶渡喻指河桥送别。
Riverbank, Peach Leaf, tread waves ferry: "Peach Leaf Ferry" is the ferry where Wang Xianzhi famously saw off his concubine Peach Leaf, representing a farewell place. Here, the riverbank Peach Leaf Ferry metaphorically refers to the river bridge farewell.

阳台半霎云何处："阳台"源自楚王梦遇巫山神女的典故，代指男女欢爱，此处感叹昨夜欢爱如阳台云雨般短暂。
Yang Terrace, half a moment, clouds where?: "Yang Terrace" originates from the King of Chu's dream of the Goddess of Wu Mountain, representing romantic love. Here, it laments that last night's joy was as brief as clouds and rain at Yang Terrace.

潇湘染就斑文箸："潇湘"源自湘妃泪洒斑竹的典故，湘妃泪染青竹成斑，此处以泪染衣袖如斑竹，形容悲伤落泪。
Xiao and Xiang dye into mottled patterned sleeves: "Xiao and Xiang" originates from the story of the Xiang Consorts' tears staining the bamboo mottled. Here, tears staining sleeves like mottled bamboo describes sad and weeping.

芙蓉帐额寒凝绿："芙蓉帐"指华丽的帐幔，"寒凝绿"形容帐幔因无人而寒冷，暗指离别后闺中孤寂。
Hibiscus curtain valence, cold congeals green: "Hibiscus curtain" refers to magnificent bed curtains; "cold congeals green" describes the curtains cold due to absence, subtly indicating the loneliness in the women's quarters after parting.

蘼芜怕作相逢路："蘼芜"源自古诗"上山采蘼芜，下山逢故夫"，代指重逢之路，此处担忧重逢之路渺茫。
Ligusticum fears becoming the meeting road: "Ligusticum" originates from the old poem "Ascend the mountain gather ligusticum, descend the mountain meet former husband," representing the road to reunion. Here, it worries the road to reunion is distant and uncertain.

鸳鸯隔南浦："南浦"为古代送别常用意象，江淹"送君南浦，伤如之何"，"鸳鸯隔南浦"指夫妻如鸳鸯被南浦阻隔。
Mandarin ducks separated by Southern Bank: "Southern Bank" is a common farewell image; Jiang Yan wrote "Seeing you off at Southern Bank, how it hurts!" "Mandarin ducks separated by Southern Bank" means the couple, like mandarin ducks, are separated by the Southern Bank.

镜里鸾孤："鸾"常喻夫妻，"镜里鸾孤"指镜中只映出孤单的自己，形容离别后形单影只。
Mirror inside, simurgh alone: "Simurgh" often metaphorically represents the couple. "Mirror inside, simurgh alone" means the mirror only reflects the lonely self, describing being alone after parting.

王粲从军朔土：王粲为东汉文学家，曾避乱荆州，作《登楼赋》抒发思乡之情，此处以王粲从军喻指李生赴边。
Wang Can joins the army in northern lands: Wang Can was an Eastern Han writer who sought refuge in Jingzhou and wrote "Rhapsody on Ascending the Tower" expressing homesickness. Here, Wang Can joining the army metaphorically refers to Scholar Li going to the frontier.

小乔初嫁东吴：小乔为周瑜之妻，以美貌闻名，此处以小乔初嫁喻指自己新婚即离别。
Xiao Qiao newly married to Eastern Wu: Xiao Qiao was Zhou Yu's wife, renowned for her beauty. Here, Xiao Qiao's new marriage metaphorically refers to her own recent marriage followed immediately by parting.

皎日之誓：源自《诗经·王风·大车》"谓予不信，有如皎日"，指以白日为誓，表诚信不渝，此处生以皎日起誓坚守盟约。
Bright sun oath: Originates from "Classic of Poetry · Wang Feng · Great Cart": "If you say I am not faithful, there is the bright sun," meaning swearing by the bright sun to express unwavering sincerity. Here, the young scholar swears by the bright sun to uphold the vow.

夫人城倾城怎遇："夫人城"为东晋苻登妻毛氏所守之城，以英勇闻名，此处赞旦的美貌与品性无人能及。
Furen City topples cities, how to encounter?: "Furen City" was a city defended by Mao Shi, wife of Fu Deng (Eastern Jin), renowned for her bravery. Here, it praises the female lead's beauty and character as unmatched.

红亭僝僽："红亭"为送别之所，"僝僽"指忧愁不安，形容在送别亭因离别而忧愁。
Red Pavilion, vexed and troubled: "Red Pavilion" is a place for farewells; "vexed and troubled" means worried and uneasy. It describes the sorrow and anxiety at the farewell pavilion due to parting.

仗剑对尊酒，耻为离别颜：源自王维等诗人的边塞诗意境，指男儿应慷慨赴边，不以离别为耻，此处韦、崔以此劝生。
Lean on sword, face honored wine, ashamed to show a parting face: Originates from the frontier poetry artistic conception of Wang Wei and others, meaning a man should go to the frontier vehement, not ashamed of parting. Here, Wei and Cui use this to advise the young scholar.

渭城今雨清尘：源自王维《送元二使安西》"渭城朝雨浥轻尘"，"今雨"指新朋友或当下的雨，此处化用诗句描绘送别时的清新场景。
Weicheng present rain clears dust: Originates from Wang Wei's "Seeing Off Yuan Second Envoy to Anxi": "Weicheng morning rain moistens light dust." "Present rain" can mean new friends or the current rain. Here, the line is adapted to depict the fresh scene at farewell.

轮台古月黄云："轮台"为古代西域地名，常出现在边塞诗中，"古月黄云"描绘边疆苍凉景象，烘托从军氛围。
Luntai ancient moon, yellow clouds: "Luntai" is an ancient place name in the Western Regions, often appearing in frontier poetry. "Ancient moon, yellow clouds" depicts the desolate frontier scene, enhancing the atmosphere of joining the army.

催花羯鼓："羯鼓"为古代打击乐器，唐玄宗曾击羯鼓催花，此处"催花羯鼓"指急促的鼓声催促从军。
Urge flowers, jie drum: "Jie drum" is an ancient percussion instrument; Emperor Xuanzong of Tang once played it to urge flowers to bloom. Here, "urge flowers, jie drum" means the urgent drum beats joining the army.

折柳：古代送别常折柳相赠，"柳"与"留"谐音，表挽留之意，"魂销折柳"形容离别时的伤感。
Break willow: Often done at farewells in ancient times; "willow" sounds like "stay", expressing a wish to detain. "Soul melts breaking willow" describes the sadness of parting.

玉堂年少："玉堂"指翰林院，"玉堂年少"指年轻的翰林官员，此处指李生身为新科状元却要赴边。
Jade Hall youth: "Jade Hall" refers to the Hanlin Academy; "Jade Hall youth" means a young Hanlin official. Here, it refers to Scholar Li being the new top graduate yet having to go to the frontier.

灞陵高处，犹自帝城春："灞陵"为送别之地，"帝城春"指京城仍留春色，反衬边疆的苍凉与离别的不舍。
Baling high place, still the imperial city's spring: "Baling" is a farewell place; "imperial city's spring" means the capital still retains spring scenery. It contrasts with the frontier's desolation and the reluctance to part.

陇头水：即陇山流水，古代有《陇头水》曲，多写离别悲苦，"分流水是断肠流"以陇头水喻指离别的愁苦。
Longtou water: i.e., the flowing water of Long Mountain; there was an ancient tune "Longtou Water" often about parting sorrow. "Dividing flowing water is heartbreak flow" uses Longtou water to metaphorize the sorrow of parting.

笳鸣笛引："笳""笛"均为边塞乐器，其声悲凉，"笳鸣笛引"以乐器声烘托边疆的凄清与思乡之情。
Reed pipes cry, flutes lead: Both "reed pipes" and "flutes" are frontier instruments with mournful sounds. "Reed pipes cry, flutes lead" uses the instrument sounds to enhance the frontier's desolation and homesickness.

梅花落尽："梅花落"为古曲名，常表思乡，"不管梅花落尽"指不顾思乡之情，专注从军事务。
Plum blossoms fall completely: "Plum Blossoms Fall" is an ancient tune name, often expressing homesickness. "Regardless of plum blossoms falling completely" means ignoring homesickness, focusing on military affairs.

天街旄头犹未郧："旄头"为星宿名，象征军事，"未郧"指未坠落，表边疆仍有战事，需立功平定。
Heavenly Street banner head not yet fallen: "Banner head" is a star name symbolizing military affairs; "not yet fallen" means not yet set, indicating there are still military campaigns on the frontier requiring merit to pacify.

紫阁山中月："紫阁山"为长安附近名山，代指家乡，"心期紫阁山中月"表达对家乡的思念与期盼。
Purge Pavilion Mountain moon: "Purge Pavilion Mountain" is a famous mountain near Chang'an, representing home. "Heart longs for Purge Pavilion Mountain moon" expresses longing and hope for home.

戎衣今作李将军："李将军"指汉代名将李广，此处以李将军喻指李生，盼其从军立功如李广。
Martial clothes now become General Li: "General Li" refers to the famous Han general Li Guang. Here, General Li metaphorically refers to Scholar Li, hoping he will achieve military merit like Li Guang.

阳关：源自《阳关三叠》离别曲，"唱阳关春事休"指唱着离别曲，美好的春光也仿佛结束，烘托离别伤感。
Yang Pass: Originates from the farewell song "Parting at Yang Pass Three Times." "Sing Yang Pass, spring affairs cease" means singing the farewell song, the beautiful spring seems to end, enhancing the sorrow of parting.

阳台岫："阳台"源自楚王梦遇巫山神女的典故，代指男女欢爱之所，"倚定个阳台岫"回想昔日欢爱场景。
Yang Terrace peak: "Yang Terrace" originates from the King of Chu's dream, representing a place of romantic love. "Leaning against a Yang Terrace peak" recalls past scenes of joy.

蓝桥遇仙：源自裴航在蓝桥驿遇云英结为夫妻的故事，此处指李生如裴航般奇遇良缘，与旦结为夫妻。
Blue Bridge encounter immortal: Originates from the story of Pei Hang meeting Yunying at Blue Bridge Post Station and marrying her. Here, it means Scholar Li, like Pei Hang, encountered a wonderful match by chance and married the female lead.

鹡鸰儿答救："鹡鸰"源自《诗经·小雅·常棣》"鹡鸰在原，兄弟急难"，以鹡鸰喻兄弟，指希望韦、崔如兄弟般在急难时相助。
Wagtail answers rescue: "Wagtail" originates from "Classic of Poetry · Xiao Ya · Chang Di": "Wagtails on the plain, brothers in urgent difficulty," using wagtails to metaphorically represent brothers. It means hoping Wei and Cui will help like brothers in times of urgent need.

杂佩以赠之：源自《诗经·郑风·女曰鸡鸣》"知子之来之，杂佩以赠之"，"杂佩"为古代玉佩，此处指以财物相赠，表托付之意。
Assorted pendants to give him: Originates from "Classic of Poetry · Zheng Feng · The Lady Says the Cock Crows": "Knowing you are coming, I give you assorted pendants." "Assorted pendants" were ancient jade pendants. Here, it means giving money or goods, expressing entrustment.

报琼玖：源自《诗经·卫风·木瓜》"投我以木桃，报之以琼玖"，指受赠后以厚礼回报，此处表韦、崔会回报旦的托付与资助。
Repay with fine jade: Originates from "Classic of Poetry · Wei Feng · Quince": "You throw me a quince, I repay you with fine jade," meaning repaying a gift with a more valuable one. Here, it expresses Wei and Cui will repay the female lead's entrustment and support.

青雀传言："青雀"为传说中传递书信的神鸟，代指信使，"付青雀传言他即溜"指托人传递消息要迅速。
Blue bird conveys message: "Blue bird" is a mythical bird that carried messages, representing a messenger. "Entrust the blue bird to convey the message, he is slippery" means to entrust someone to deliver a message quickly.

撑犁大："撑犁"为匈奴语"天"之意，"撑犁大"即天大地大，此处指番家以天地为家的豪迈。
Vast Chengli: "Chengli" is the Xiongnu word for "heaven." "Vast Chengli" means heaven is vast, earth is vast. Here, it means the foreign tribe considers heaven and earth their home, showing boldness.

逻娑：即逻些，为古代吐蕃都城（今拉萨），此处代指吐蕃领地，"逻娑一望无边际"描绘吐蕃疆域辽阔。
Lhasa: i.e., Lhasa, the ancient capital of Tibet, here representing Tibetan territory. "Lhasa, one glance, no boundary" depicts the vastness of the Tibetan domain.

把都们："把都"为蒙古语"勇士"之意，此处指番将部下的勇士们。
Baghaturs: "Baghatur" is Mongolian for "warrior, hero." Here, it refers to the warriors under the foreign general.

铁里温都答喇：少数民族语言拟声词，可能为呼号声或战吼声，烘托番军的粗犷气势。
Teliwendudala: An onomatopoeic phrase from a minority language, possibly a shout or war cry, enhancing the rough, imposing manner of the foreign army.

葡萄酒熟了香打辣："打辣"为方言，指香气浓烈，此处写大河西国葡萄酒成熟时香气浓烈，吸引番军抢掠。
Grape wine ripe, fragrance pungent: "Pungent" is dialect for intense fragrance. Here, it writes that the Great River West Country's grape wine, when ripe, has a strong fragrance, attracting the foreign army to plunder.

雪山花：指雪山景色，"刬起雪山花"形容番军骑马奔驰时踏起的雪尘如飞花，显行军之速。
Snow mountain flowers: Refers to the snow mountain scenery. "Plow up snow mountain flowers" describes the foreign army on horseback kicking up snow dust like flying flowers, showing their speed of march.

牙旗翻翠葆："牙旗"为将军大旗，"翠葆"指饰有翠羽的车盖，代指仪仗，此处写军阵仪仗鲜明。
Command flag flutters, kingfisher-feathered canopy: "Command flag" is the general's large flag; "kingfisher-feathered canopy" refers to a canopy adorned with kingfisher feathers, representing the ceremonial regalia. Here, it writes of the bright flags and regalia of the army formation.

大树将军老："大树将军"指东汉冯异，因常独屏树下得名，喻指不居功的将领，此处刘公济自比冯异，显谦逊。
Great Tree General old: "Great Tree General" refers to Feng Yi (Eastern Han), so named because he often sat alone under a tree, metaphorically meaning a general who does not claim credit. Here, Liu Gongji compares himself to Feng Yi, showing humility.

酒泉乡："酒泉"为古代西北郡名，以产酒闻名，"封侯只爱酒泉乡"指愿在边疆建功立业，享受边地生活。
Jiuquan homeland: "Jiuquan" is an ancient northwestern commandery famous for wine production. "Enfeoffed as marquis only love Jiuquan homeland" means wishing to achieve merit on the frontier and enjoy frontier life.

紫塞夜摇风角："紫塞"指长城，"风角"为古代占候乐器，此处写边塞夜晚风声与军乐交织，显边地氛围。
Purple Frontier night shakes wind horn: "Purple Frontier" refers to the Great Wall; "wind horn" is an ancient wind instrument used for divination. Here, it writes of the frontier night with wind sounds and military music interwoven, showing the frontier atmosphere.

幕中邀谢鉴，麾下得周郎："谢鉴"指谢安，善识人；"周郎"指周瑜，善治军，此处赞李益如谢安般有识、如周瑜般有才。
Within the tent, invite Xie's discernment; under the command, obtain Zhou's talent: "Xie's discernment" refers to Xie An, good at recognizing talent; "Zhou's talent" refers to Zhou Yu, good at managing armies. Here, it praises Li Yi for having discernment like Xie An and talent like Zhou Yu.

非熊奇貌，卧龙风调："非熊"指姜太公，"卧龙"指诸葛亮，以两位贤臣喻刘公济的才德与风范。
Feixiong's strange appearance, Crouching Dragon's style: "Feixiong" refers to Jiang Taigong (Lü Shang); "Crouching Dragon" refers to Zhuge Liang. Using these two worthy ministers to metaphorically represent Liu Gongji's talent, virtue, and demeanor.

图画在麒麟第一高："麒麟"指麒麟阁，汉宣帝绘功臣像于麒麟阁，此处祝愿刘公济功绩能列麒麟阁首位。
Painted in Qilin, first and highest: "Qilin" refers to the Qilin Pavilion, where Emperor Xuan of Han painted portraits of meritorious officials. Here, it wishes Liu Gongji's achievements to rank first in the Qilin Pavilion.

王粲登楼之才：王粲作《登楼赋》抒怀，喻指文才出众；"李白吓蛮之计"指李白以文威慑蛮夷，此处赞李生有文韬武略。
Wang Can's talent of ascending the tower: Wang Can wrote "Rhapsody on Ascending the Tower" to express his feelings, metaphorically meaning outstanding literary talent; "Li Bai's plan to frighten barbarians" refers to Li Bai using literary power to overawe barbarians. Here, it praises Scholar Li for having both literary and military strategy.

单则是玉门关外老班超："班超"为东汉名将，投笔从戎立功西域，此处以班超喻指愿在玉门关建功立业，如班超般终老边疆。
Simply it's old Ban Chao beyond Jade Gate Pass: Ban Chao was a famous Eastern Han general who abandoned writing to join the army and achieved merit in the Western Regions. Here, Ban Chao metaphorically represents the wish to achieve merit beyond Jade Gate Pass, like Ban Chao who grew old on the frontier.

檄书端可愈头风：源自"檄愈头风"典故，指陈琳檄文能治曹操头风，此处指檄文威力强大，可震慑敌军。
Proclamation truly can cure headache: Originates from the story "proclamation cures headache," where Chen Lin's proclamation cured Cao Cao's headache. Here, it means the proclamation is powerful and can震慑 the enemy army.

昔汉西域说开萄葡归汉：源自张骞出使西域引入葡萄的典故，指汉代开拓西域将葡萄等物产引入中原，此处借历史强调大唐对河西的主权。
Formerly Han's Western Regions account says grapes opened and returned to Han: Originates from the story of Zhang Qian's mission to the Western Regions introducing grapes, meaning the Han expansion into the Western Regions brought products like grapes to the Central Plains. Here, it uses history to emphasize the Tang's sovereignty over Hexi.

依样画葫芦：俗语，指模仿别人做事，此处吐番将嘲讽大河西降唐是模仿他人，毫无主见。
Draw a gourd according to the pattern: A saying meaning to imitate others. Here, the Tibetan general mocks the Great River West's surrender to Tang as imitation, lacking independent judgment.

打几阵战河西得胜鼓："得胜鼓"为古代军队凯旋时演奏的乐曲，此处指吐番将扬言要在河西作战并奏凯，表挑战之意。
Fight several battles west of the river, victory drum: "Victory drum" was music played by ancient armies upon triumphant return. Here, it means the Tibetan general boasts of fighting west of the river and achieving victory, expressing a challenge.

登楼赋：东汉王粲所作，抒发思乡与怀才不遇之情，此处"知君不少登楼赋"以王粲之才赞李生文才出众。
Rhapsody on Ascending the Tower: Written by Wang Can (Eastern Han), expressing homesickness and frustration at unrecognized talent. Here, "know you have no small amount of Rhapsody on Ascending the Tower" uses Wang Can's talent to praise Scholar Li's outstanding literary skill.

袁绍杯：袁绍为东汉诸侯，善招纳贤才，"初逢袁绍杯"指如遇袁绍般的知己，获礼遇与赏识。
Yuan Shao's cup: Yuan Shao was an Eastern Han warlord good at recruiting talent. "First meet Yuan Shao's cup" means meeting a patron like Yuan Shao, receiving courtesy and appreciation.

围棋赌墅：源自谢安在淝水之战时下棋赌别墅的典故，形容临危不乱的气度，此处生以谢安自比显从容。
Weiqi gamble villa: Originates from the story of Xie An gambling his villa during a game of weiqi (Go) at the Battle of Fei River, describing composure under pressure. Here, the young scholar compares himself to Xie An to show calmness.

顿逊醍醐："顿逊"为古代东南亚古国，盛产香料；"醍醐"指美酒，"香浮顿逊醍醐"形容葡萄酒香气如醍醐般醇厚。
Dunxun ghee: "Dunxun" was an ancient Southeast Asian kingdom rich in spices; "ghee" refers to fine wine. "Fragrance floats, Dunxun ghee" describes the grape wine's aroma as rich as ghee.

酒泉移封，凉州换取："酒泉""凉州"均为西北地名，以产酒闻名，此处赞葡萄酒珍贵，可换封地。
Jiuquan move fief, Liangzhou exchange: Both "Jiuquan" and "Liangzhou" are northwestern place names famous for wine production. Here, it praises the grape wine's preciousness, worth exchanging for fiefs.

冰井沉余："冰井"指藏冰的井，"沉余"指留存的凉意，形容镇心瓜如冰井藏冰般清凉。
Ice well sinks remainder: "Ice well" refers to a well for storing ice; "sinks remainder" means remaining coolness. It describes the heart-calming melon as cool as ice stored in a well.

望京楼：指眺望京城的楼，"飞楼外，望京何处"表达对京城的思念，暗含归乡之情。
Gaze-at-Capital Tower: Refers to a tower for gazing towards the capital. "Outside the flying tower, gaze towards the capital where?" expresses longing for the capital, implicitly containing the desire to return home.

受降城：唐代所筑接受边疆投降的城池，"早则秋风别哨关南路"指秋日将赴受降城执行军务。
Surrender Acceptance City: Cities built in the Tang Dynasty to accept the surrender of frontier peoples. "Early then autumn wind, farewell outpost pass south road" means going to Surrender Acceptance City in autumn for military duties.

喻檄还朝赋子虚："檄"指军中文书，"子虚"指司马相如《子虚赋》，指完成军务后以文才还朝，如赋子虚般受赏识。
Metaphorical proclamation return to court, compose Zixu Rhapsody: "Proclamation" means military document; "Zixu" refers to Sima Xiangru's "Rhapsody on the Imperial Park." It means after completing military duties, return to court with literary talent and receive appreciation like composing a rhapsody.

一品当朝横玉带，姻连外戚，势游中贵："一品当朝"指身居最高官位，"外戚"指帝王母族或妻族，"中贵"指宦官，此处写卢太尉位高权重，与外戚、宦官勾结。
First rank in court, traverse jade belt; marriage connects to outer relatives; power associates with inner nobles: "First rank in court" means holding the highest official rank; "outer relatives" means the emperor's maternal or wifely relatives; "inner nobles" means powerful eunuchs. Here, it writes that Grand Marshal Lu holds high rank and power, colluding with outer relatives and eunuchs.

贾生空遇圣明君："贾生"指贾谊，西汉文学家，虽遇汉文帝却未得重用，此处以贾谊喻指李益有才却遭排挤，暗讽卢太尉打压贤才。
Scholar Jia vainly met a sage and bright ruler: "Scholar Jia" refers to Jia Yi, a Western Han writer who, though encountering Emperor Wen of Han, was not heavily employed. Here, Jia Yi metaphorically represents Li Yi's talent being sidelined, subtly satirizing Grand Marshal Lu's suppression of worthy talent.

折简求三益："折简"指写信，"三益"指三种益友，源自《论语》"友直，友谅，友多闻，益矣"，此处指卢太尉写信邀请益友商议。
Break bamboo slip, seek three benefits: "Break bamboo slip" means write a letter; "three benefits" refers to three beneficial types of friends,from "Analects": "Friends who are upright, friends who are sincere, friends who are widely informed, are beneficial." Here, it means Grand Marshal Lu writes letters inviting beneficial friends to discuss.

千金赋今人不买："千金赋"指珍贵的文章，源自司马相如作赋得千金典故，此处指李益的才学不被当世重视，反招祸患。
Thousand-gold rhapsody, present people do not buy: "Thousand-gold rhapsody" means precious literary work,from the story of Sima Xiangru receiving a thousand gold for his rhapsody. Here, it means Li Yi's talent and learning are not valued by his contemporaries, instead bringing trouble.

贾长沙干死了洛阳才："贾长沙"即贾谊，曾为长沙王太傅，此处以贾谊抑郁而死喻指担心李益如贾谊般因才遭忌而不得志。
Jia Changsha dried up and died Luoyang talent: "Jia Changsha" is Jia Yi, who served as tutor to the Prince of Changsha. Here, Jia Yi's depression and death metaphorically represent the worry that Li Yi, like Jia Yi, will be envied for his talent and fail to achieve his ambitions.

庙堂除拜："庙堂"指朝廷，"除拜"指任命官职，"文章士自有庙堂除拜"指文人应有朝廷正式任命，而非屈身军中。
Temple hall appointment: "Temple hall" refers to the court; "appointment" means official appointment. "Literary scholars naturally have temple hall appointments" means scholars should have formal court appointments, not humble themselves in the army.

白玉阶：代指朝廷殿堂，"曾如站立在白玉阶"反问李益在军中是否能如在朝廷般受重视，暗含对其处境的同情。
White jade steps: Represent the court hall. "Ever like standing on white jade steps" rhetorically asks if Li Yi in the army can be as valued as in the court, implicitly sympathizing with his situation.
古来书记都不是翰林才："书记"指军中掌文书的官员，"翰林才"指翰林学士的才学，此处卢太尉强辩军中书记也可由翰林才担任，为招揽李益找借口。
E: Since ancient times, clerks have not been Hanlin talents: "Clerk" refers to the official in charge of documents in the army;  Hanlin talent" refers to the scholarly ability of a Hanlin Academician. Here, Marshal Lu insists that an army clerk could also be filled by a Hanlin talent, making an excuse to recruit Li Yi.

C: 打凤捞龙意不休："打凤捞龙"比喻网罗贤才，此处指卢太尉一心想将李益纳入掌控的意图。
E: "Beat the phoenix and dredge the dragon" without cease: "Beat the phoenix and dredge the dragon" is a metaphor for recruiting talented individuals. Here, it refers to Marshal Lu's persistent intention to bring Li Yi under his control.

C: 双星：指牵牛星和织女星，传说七夕鹊桥相会，此处"同拜双星"指七夕祭拜牛郎织女，祈求姻缘美满。
E: Twin Stars: Refer to the stars Altair (the Cowherd) and Vega (the Weaver Maid). Legend says they meet on a magpiebridge on the Qixi Festival (Double Seventh Night). Here, "worshipping the twin stars together" refers to making offerings to the Cowherd and Weaver Maid on Qixi to pray for a happy marriage.

C: 乌鹊桥成：传说七夕乌鹊搭桥使牛郎织女相会，"乌鹊桥成上界通"描绘七夕鹊桥相连、天人相会的传说场景。

The Magpie Bridge is formed: Legend says that on Qixi, magpies form a bridge allowing the Cowherd and Weaver Maid to meet. The line "乌鹊桥成上界通" depicts the legendary scene of the magpie bridge connecting and the celestial lovers meeting.
穿针故事：七夕传统习俗，女子当庭穿针，祈求手巧，"莫非穿针故事乎"点明七夕乞巧的习俗。
E: The tale of threading the needle: A traditional Qixi custom where women thread needles in the courtyard to pray for dexterity. The line "Is it perhaps the story of threading a needle?" explicitly mentions the Qixi custom of praying for  kill .

C: 机中织女啼红迸："机中织女"指织女星，传说织女善织，"啼红迸"想象织女因相思而落泪，暗合七夕相思主题。
E: The Weaver at her loom sheds crimson tears: "Weaver at her loom" refers to the star Vega (Weaver Maid), legendary for her weaving skill. "Sheds crimson tears" imagines the Weaver Maid weeping tears of blood from longing, fitting the Qixi theme of yearning.

C: 柔情似水，佳期如梦：化用秦观《鹊桥仙》"柔情似水，佳期如梦"，形容七夕相会的柔情与短暂，暗喻剧中人物相聚的珍贵。
E: Tender as water, the happy time like a dream: Adapted from Qin Guan's "Queqiaoxian" (Immortal at the Magpie Bridge): "Love is like water, and the good time is like a dream". It describes the tenderness and brevity of the Qixi meeting, metaphorically alluding to the preciousness of the characters' reunion in the play.

C: 百子池边，长生殿上："百子池"为古代宫中池名，"长生殿"为华清宫殿名，均与七夕、爱情相关，借历史典故烘托浪漫氛围。
E: By the Hundred Sons Pond, in the Longevity Hall: "Hundred Sons Pond" was the name of a pond in the ancient palace; "Longevity Hall" was the name of a hall in the Huaqing Palace. Both are associated with Qixi and love, using historical allusions to create a romantic atmosphere.

C: 钿合金钗：源自白居易《长恨歌》"钿合金钗寄将去"，指信物，"钿合金钗，私庆似恁"以信物象征爱情的私许与喜庆。
E: Inlaid box and gold hairpin: From Bai Juyi's "Song of Everlasting Sorrow": "The gold and silver hairpin is sent away", referring to tokens of love. "Inlaid box and gold hairpin, private joy like this" uses the tokens to symbolize the private pledge and celebration of love.

C: 天孙：指织女星，因传说为天帝之女，故称"天孙"，"阿母天孙恨几端"借织女的遗憾写人间相思之苦。
E: Granddaughter of Heaven: Refers to the Weaver Maid star (Vega), as legend says she is the daughter of the Celestial Emperor, hence the name. "Mother, Granddaughter of Heaven, has many regrets" uses the Weaver Maid's regret to express the pain of earthly longing.

C: 乞巧盘：七夕用于乞巧的盘子，盛放瓜果等物，"且伴佳人乞巧盘"指参与七夕乞巧的习俗活动。
E: Qiqiao Plate: A plate used on Qixi for the Qiqiao (Praying for Skills) custom, holding melons, fruits, etc. "And accompy the beauty with the Qiqiao plate" refers to participating inthe Qiqiao custom activity on Qixi.

C: 卧看牵牛织女星：化用杜牧《秋夕》"天阶夜色凉如水，卧看牵牛织女星"，借诗句抒发七夕夜的相思与怅惘。
E: Lying down watching the Cowherd and Weaver Maid stars:

Adapted from Du Mu's "Autumn Night": "The night is cool as water, lying down to watch the stars of the Cowherd and Weaver Girl". It borrows the poetic line to express the longing and melancholy of the Qixi night.

C: 紫塞：代指北方边塞。晋代崔豹《古今注·都邑》："秦筑长城，土色皆紫，汉塞亦然，故称紫塞焉。"原句意思是秦代修筑的长城，土色都是紫色的，汉代的边塞也是如此，所以称为"紫塞"。这里用来描绘北方边塞的景象。
E: Purple Frontier: Refers to the northern frontier. Cui Bao of the Jin Dynasty in "Notes on Ancient and Modern Matters · Capitals": "The Qin built the Great Wall, the earth was all purple; the Han frontiers were also like this, hence called the Purple Frontier." The original meaning is that the earth of the Qin Great Wall was purple, and the Han frontiers were too, hence the name. Here it is used to depict the scene of the northern frontier.

C: 铜符帐：指主将的营帐。铜符，古代朝廷用作信物的铜制虎符，这里代指主将的职权。
E: Tent of the Bronze Tiger Tally: Refers to the commander's tent. "Bronze tally" refers to the bronze tiger tally used by the imperial court as a credential, here representing the commander's authority.

C: 龙荒：指北方荒漠地区。《后汉书·班超传》："定远慷慨，专功西遐。坦步葱、雪，咫尺龙沙。"李贤注："葱、雪，山名也。龙沙，即白龙堆，沙形如龙，故曰龙沙。"原句意思是班超慷慨激昂，专门在西方建立功勋，从容地行走在葱岭、雪山之间，距离白龙堆很近。这里"龙荒"用来形容边疆荒凉的地域。
E: Dragon Desert: Refers to the northern desert regions. "Book of the Later Han · Biography of Ban Chao": "Dingyuan [Ban Chao] was fervent, dedicated to achieving merit in the distant west. He strode calmly through the Congling and Snowy Mountains, close to Longsha." Li Xian's annotation: "Cong, Snow, are mountain names. Longsha is the White Dragon Mound, the sand shaped like a dragon, hence the name Longsha." The original sentence means Ban Chao was passionate, dedicated to achieving feats in the far west, walking calmly between the Congling and Snowy Mountains, very close to the White Dragon Mounds. Here "Dragon Desert" is used to describe the desolate frontier region.

C: 刁斗：古代军中用具，白天用来做饭，夜间用来打更。《史记·李将军列传》："不击刁斗以自卫。"原句意思是不敲击刁斗来自我防卫。这里描绘了军中夜晚的情景。
E: Diao Dou: An ancient military utensil, used for cooking during the day and keeping watch at night. "Records of the Grand Historian · Biography of General Li Guang": "Did not strike the Diao Dou for self-defense." The original meaning is that he did not strike the Diao Dou to defend himself. Here it depicts a nighttime scene in the army.

C: 画角：古代乐器，形状似竹筒，本细末大，以竹木或皮革制成，外加彩绘，军中多用以警昏晓。
E: Painted Horn: An ancient musical instrument, shaped like a bamboo tube, narrow at the mouthpiece and wide at the bell, made of bamboo, wood, or leather, painted on the outside. Often used in the army to signal dusk and dawn.

C: 边霜昨夜堕关榆，吹角当城片月孤：化用自唐代李益《听晓角》"边霜昨夜堕关榆，吹角当城汉月孤"。原句意思是昨夜边塞的寒霜落在了关塞的榆树上，在城头上吹奏号角时，天空中挂着一轮孤独的明月。
E: Frontier frost last night fell on the frontier elms, blowing the horn beneath the city wall, a sliver of moon hangs alone: Adapted from Li Yi's (Tang Dynasty) "Hearing the Morning Horn": "The frostfell on the elm trees last night, and the horns sounded as the Han moon stood alone". The original line means last night the frontier frost fell on the elms at the frontier pass; blowing the horn on the city wall, a lone Han moon hangs in the sky.

C: 无限塞鸿飞不度，秋风吹入小单于：出自唐代李益《听晓角》。原句意思是无数的塞鸿（边塞的鸿雁）都飞不过去，秋风却吹入了《小单于》的乐曲中。
E: Countless frontier swans cannot fly across, the autumn wind blows into the "Little Chanyu": From Li Yi's (Tang Dynasty) "Hearing the Morning Horn". The original line means countless frontier swans (wild geese of the frontier) cannot fly across [or: the music is so moving even geese won't fly past], yet the autumn wind blows into the tune of "Little Chanyu".

C: 玉门关：关名，在今甘肃敦煌西北。是古代通往西域的重要关隘，这里代指边关。
E: Jade Gate Pass: Name of a pass, northwest of modern Dunhuang, Gansu. An important pass on the ancient route to the Western Regions. Here it represents the frontier.

C: 封侯相：指封侯的将相。《后汉书·班超传》记载，班超投笔从戎，出使西域，立功封侯。这里表示在边关守定可以获得封侯的功绩。
E: Marquis and Minister: Refers to a general or minister who is

enfeoffed as a Marquis. The "Book of the Later Han · Biography of Ban Chao" records that Ban Chao threw aside his writing brush to join the army, served as an envoy to the Western Regions, achieved merit and was enfeoffed as a Marquis. Here it means that holding firm at the frontier can lead to the achievement of being enfeoffed.

C: 瑶池：古代神话中昆仑山上的池名，西王母所居。《穆天子传》卷三："乙丑，天子觞西王母于瑶池之上。"原句意思是乙丑日，周穆王在瑶池之上宴请西王母。这里用来形容边塞的荒凉之地。
E: Jade Pool: The name of a pool on Kunlun Mountain in ancient mythology, where the Queen Mother of the West resides. "Biography of King Mu, Son of Heaven", scroll 3: "On the day Yichou, the Son of Heaven feasted the Queen Mother of the West at the Jade Pool." The original sentence means on the day Yichou, King Mu of Zhou feasted the Queen Mother of the West at the Jade Pool. Here it is used to describe the desolate frontier land.

C: 梁园：西汉梁孝王所建的园林，故址在今河南商丘东。这里代指战场。
E: Liang Garden: The garden built by Prince Xiao of Liang of the Western Han Dynasty, site located east of modern Shangqiu, Henan. Here it represents the battlefield.

C: 嫦娥在女墙，照愁人白发三千丈："白发三千丈"出自唐代李白《秋浦歌十七首·其十五》"白发三千丈，缘愁似个长"。原句意思是白发长达三千丈，是因为愁绪像这样长。
E: Chang'e is on the parapet, shining on the sorrowful man whose white hair is thirty thousand feet long: "White hair thirty thousand feet long" is from Li Bai's (Tang Dynasty) "Songs of Qiupu, No. 15": "My white hair stretches three thousand feet, my sorrow as long as it is". The original line means white hair thirty thousand feet long, because my sorrow is this long.

C: 关山：这里指关隘山岭。《乐府诗集·横吹曲辞五·木兰诗》："万里赴戎机，关山度若飞。"原句意思是不远万里奔赴战场，像飞一样地跨过一道道的关，越过一座座的山。
E: Frontier Mountains: Here refers to frontier passes and mountains. "Music Bureau Poetry Collection · Songs for Horizontal Flutes No. 5 · Ballad of Mulan": "She went ten thousand miles to the war, crossing frontiers and mountains as if flying." The original line means traveling ten thousand miles to the war, crossing passes and mountains as if flying.

C: 《关山月》《思归引》：均为古代乐曲名。《关山月》多写征人思乡之情，《思归引》也是表达思乡归念之情的乐曲。
E: "Moon over the Mountain Pass", "Song of Longing for Home": Both are names of ancient musical pieces. "Moon over the Mountain Pass" often expresses the homesickness of soldiers; "Song of Longing for Home" also expresses feelings of longing for home and return.

C: 雁足吴笺好寄书：化用自"雁足传书"的典故。《汉书·苏武传》记载，苏武被匈奴扣留，后汉使要求匈奴释放苏武，匈奴谎称苏武已死。汉使则说，天子在上林苑中射猎，射得一只大雁，雁足上系着帛书，上面写着苏武还在北海边上。匈奴无奈，只好释放苏武。这里表示借助书信传递消息。
E: A letter on Wu paper tied to a goose's foot is good for sending messages: Adapted from the allusion "Message on a Goose's Foot". The "Book of Han · Biography of Su Wu" records that Su Wu was detained by the Xiongnu. Later, Han envoys demanded Su Wu's release; the Xiongnu falsely claimed Su Wu was dead. The Han envoy said the Son of Heaven was hunting in the Shanglin Park and shot a goose, which had a silk letter tied to its foot saying Su Wu was still by the North Sea. The Xiongnu had no choice but to release Su Wu. Here it means sending messages via letters.

C: 阳关：古关名，在今甘肃敦煌西南。王维《送元二使安西》有"劝君更尽一杯酒，西出阳关无故人"。这里代指边关。
E: Yang Pass: Name of an ancient pass, southwest of modern Dunhuang, Gansu. Wang Wei's "Seeing Off Yuan Er on His Mission to Anxi" contains the line: "I urge you to drink one more cup of wine; West of Yang Pass you'll meet no more old friends." Here it represents the frontier.

C: 回乐峰前沙似雪，受降城外月如霜。不知何处吹芦管，一夜征人尽望乡：出自唐代李益《夜上受降城闻笛》。原句意思是回乐峰前的沙地像雪一样洁白，受降城外的月亮像霜一样寒冷。不知道从什么地方传来了吹芦管的声音，让整个晚上征人都在思念故乡。
E: Before Huiyue Peak the sand is like snow, outside the Shouxiang City the moon is like frost. I don't know where the reed pipe is being played, making all the soldiers gaze homeward all night long: From Li Yi's (Tang Dynasty) "Hearing a Flute on the Wall of Shouxiang City at Night". The original lines mean the sand before Huiyue Peak is like snow, the moon outside Shouxiang City is like frost. I don't know where the sound of the reed pipe is coming from, making all the soldiers look towards home all night.

C: 李将军画汉宫春晓：李将军指唐代李思训，他善画山水。"汉宫春晓"是一种绘画题材，描绘汉代宫廷春天的景象。这里表示不能像李思训那样画出如《汉宫春晓》般美好的画作。
E: General Li painted "Spring Dawn in the Han Palace": General Li refers to Li Sixun of the Tang Dynasty, who was skilled at painting landscapes. "Spring Dawn in the Han Palace" is a painting theme depicting a spring scene in the Han Dynasty palace. Here it means being unable to paint a beautiful scene like "Spring Dawn in the Han Palace" as Li Sixun could.

C: 旗门占气色：古代军中通过观察旗帜附近的云气色彩来预测吉凶祸福的做法。
E: Banner Gate observes the aura: An ancient military practice of predicting good or bad fortune by observing the color of the clouds and mist near the flags.

C: 凤尾云飘：指旗帜上的装饰如凤尾般在云中飘动。凤尾常为旗帜的华美装饰，这里描绘旗帜在风中飘动的景象。
E: Phoenix tails drift in the clouds: Refers to the decorations on the flags, like phoenix tails, floating in the clouds. Phoenix tails were often ornate decorations on flags; here it depicts the scene of flags fluttering in the wind.

C: 旄头宿落：旄头，星宿名，即昴宿，古代认为旄头星出现预示有战事。"旄头宿落"指旄头星隐落，象征战事平息。
E: The Mao Banner Star falls: "Mao Banner" is the name of a
constellation, namely the Pleiades. Ancient people believed the appearance of the Mao Banner star foretold war. "The Mao Banner Star falls" means the star sets, symbolizing the cessation of war.

C: 匣剑老辘轳绣涩：辘轳，指剑身上的螺旋状花纹。此句意为剑在匣中久放，花纹因生锈而变得滞涩，形容久无战事。
E: The sword in its case is old, its spiral patterns rusted stiff: "Lulu" refers to the spiral patterns on the sword blade. This line means the sword has been stored in its case for so long that its patterns have become stiff with rust, describing a long period without war.

C: 边烽冷兜笭苔卧：边烽，边境的烽火台；兜笭，指头盔。意思是边境烽火台已冷寂，头盔上长满青苔，形容边疆安宁无战事。
E: Frontier beacon fires cold, helmets lie covered in moss: "Frontier beacon fires" are the beacon towers on the border; "Helmet" refers to a helmet. It means the frontier beacon towers are cold and silent, helmets are covered in moss, describing a peaceful frontier without war.

C: 清时：太平盛世。
E: Time of peace: Peaceful and prosperous age.

C: 紫逻：指边塞的关隘要道。
E: Purple Logic: Refers to the strategic passes and routes on the frontier.

C: 牙幢：古代将军的营帐前的旗帜，代指将军营帐。
E: Command Tent Pennant: The flag in front of an ancient general's tent, representing the general's headquarters.

C: 貂蝉：古代高官帽子上的装饰，代指高官。
E: Marten Tails and Cicadas: Decorations on the hats of ancient high officials, representing high officials.

C: 独携堂印坐西州：西州，指西部地区，这里代指边疆。意为独自携带官印镇守边疆。
E: Alone carrying the hall seal, sitting in Xizhou: "Xizhou" refers to the western regions, here representing the frontier. It means guarding the frontier alone, carrying the official seal.

C: 一剑霜飞雁影秋：化用边塞诗中常见意象，以剑上凝霜、雁影随秋，描绘边疆的肃杀与辽阔。
E: One sword, frost flies, goose shadows autumn: Uses common imagery from frontier poetry: frost on the sword, goose shadows in autumn, depicting the harshness and vastness of the frontier.

C: 班超容易老：班超，东汉名将，投笔从戎出使西域，年老思乡。这里用班超的典故感叹时光易逝，功业难成。
E: Ban Chao aged easily: Ban Chao, a famous general of the Eastern Han Dynasty, threw aside his brush to join the army and served as an envoy to the Western Regions; he grew old and longed for home in his later years. Here, Ban Chao's allusion is used to lament how time flies and achievements are hard to secure.

C: 李广不封侯：李广，西汉名将，多次征战匈奴却未得封侯。出自《史记·李将军列传》，这里用李广的典故感慨功名难就。
E: Li Guang never became a Marquis: Li Guang, a famous general of the Western Han Dynasty, fought the Xiongnu many times but was never enfeoffed as a Marquis. From "Records of the Grand Historian · Biography of General Li Guang". Here, Li Guang's allusion is used to lament the difficulty of achieving fame and rank.

C: 推毂：古代指推荐人才或协助帝王推行仁政，这里指镇守边疆、治理一方。
E: Pushing the Chariot Wheels: In ancient times, it meant recommending talent or assisting the emperor in implementing benevolent governance. Here it means guarding the frontier and governing the region.

C: 袁本初书记，时有优渥之言：袁本初，即袁绍，东汉末年诸侯，他对待部下常有优厚的言辞。这里李益以袁绍部下自比，感谢刘节镇的优待。
E: Yuan Benchu's [Yuan Shao] clerk often received generous words: Yuan Benchu, i.e., Yuan Shao, a warlord of the late Eastern Han Dynasty, often used generous words with his subordinates. Here, Li Yi compares himself to a subordinate of Yuan Shao, thanking Commander Liu for his preferential treatment.

C: 王仲宣从军，不无思乡之感：王仲宣，即王粲，东汉末年文学家，曾随军征战，作《登楼赋》抒发思乡之情。这里李益借王粲的典故表达自己的思乡之情。
E: Wang Zhongxuan [Wang Can] joining the army was not without feelings of homesickness: Wang Zhongxuan, i.e., Wang Can, a writer of the late Eastern Han Dynasty, once accompanied the army on campaign and wrote "Rhapsody on Climbing the Tower" to express his homesickness. Here, Li Yi uses Wang Can's allusion to express his own homesickness.

C: 归衮：指官员被召回朝廷担任要职，衮指古代高官的礼服。
E: Return in Dragon Robes: Refers to an official being recalled to the court to assume an important post. "Gun" refers to the ceremonial robes of ancient high officials.

C: 迁莺：出自《诗经·小雅·伐木》"伐木丁丁，鸟鸣嘤嘤。出自幽谷，迁于乔木"，后以迁莺比喻升官或迁居。
E: Transferred Oriole: From the "Classic of Poetry · Minor Odes · Cutting Down Trees": "Cutting trees ding-ding, birds cry ying-ying. They come out of the dark valley, move to the tall tree." Later, "transferring the oriole" became a metaphor for promotion or moving residence.

C: 虎变龙蒸：比喻事业兴旺发达，前程远大。
E: Tiger's Change, Dragon's Ascent: A metaphor for a flourishing career and a bright future.

C: 元戎：古代对主帅、大将军的称呼。
E: Commander-in-Chief: An ancient term for the supreme commander or general.

C: 参佐：指军中的参谋辅佐官员。
E: Aides and Advisors: Refers to staff officers and advisory officials in the army.

C: 情无那：指情绪难以抑制。
E: Emotions are unbearable: Means the emotions are difficult to suppress.

C: 倚天剑，回日戈：倚天剑，传说中锋利的宝剑；回日戈，神话中能让太阳回转的戈，均比喻强大的军事力量。
E: Sword that Rests on the Sky, Halberd that Turns Back the Sun: "Sword that Rests on the Sky" is a legendary sharp sword; "Halberd that Turns Back the Sun" is a mythical halberd that could make the sun reverse its course. Both metaphorically represent powerful military strength.

C: 阴符：古代的兵书，传为姜太公所作。
E: Secret Tallies: An ancient military text, traditionally attributed to Jiang Ziya (Taigong).

C: 洗兵风坐挽银河：化用"洗兵雨"的典故，指以风雨洗涤兵器，准备战事，这里形容军事力量强大，能扭转战局。
E: Washing weapons in the wind, sitting and pulling back the Milky Way: Adapts the allusion "rain that washes weapons"  meaning using wind and rain to cleanse weapons in preparation for war. Here it describes powerful military strength capable of turning the tide of battle.

C: 陵烟汉将：指东汉明帝时将开国功臣画像置于云台，这里代指功勋卓著的将领。
E: Tomb-Smoke Han Generals: Refers to the practice of Emperor Ming of the Eastern Han Dynasty placing portraits of founding meritorious officials in he Cloud Terrace. Here it represents generals of outstanding merit.

C: 尊俎投壶听雅歌：尊俎，指宴席；投壶，古代宴会上的一种游戏；雅歌，指典雅的诗歌。形容军中宴饮时的文雅景象。
E: Wine vessels and stands, pitch-pot, listening to elegant songs: "Zun zu" refers to the banquet; "touhu" is an ancient game played at banquets; "elegant songs" refers to refined poetry. It describes an elegant scene at a military banquet.

C: 信宿：指连住两夜。
E: Staying two nights: Means staying for two consecutive nights.

C: 黄金斗大，肘间悬龟纹绶花：龟纹绶花，古代高官系印的绶带，上有龟纹装饰。形容官印与绶带的贵重，代指高官职权。
E: Gold seal big as a dou measure, tortoise-patterned ribbon flowers hanging at the elbow: "Tortoise-patterned ribbon flowers" refers to the ribbon used by ancient high officials to carry their seals, decorated with tortoise patterns. It describes the value of the official seal and ribbon, representing high official authority.

C: 如姬要不的他闲偷把：如姬，战国时魏王的宠妃，曾为信陵君窃符救赵。出自《史记·魏公子列传》，这里用如姬窃符的典故，提醒保管好兵符。
E: Ru Ji couldn't idly steal it for him: Ru Ji, a favorite concubine of the King of Wei during the Warring States period, once stole the tiger tally for Lord Xinling to save Zhao. From "Records of the Grand Historian · Biographies of the Hereditary Houses of Wei". Here, the allusion of Ru Ji stealing the tally is used to remind one to keep the military tally safe.

C: 朱司农用不着那横文打：朱司农，指汉代朱买臣，曾因贫困被妻子嫌弃，后官至司农。这里意为兵符并非如朱买臣的文书那般随意使用，强调兵符的重要性。
E: Minister of Agriculture Zhu had no use for that horizontal script beating: "Minister of Agriculture Zhu" refers to Zhu Maichen of the Han Dynasty, who was despised by his wife due to poverty but later rose to be Minister of Agriculture. Here it means the military tally is not to be used casually like Zhu Maichen's documents (perhaps referring to his firewood bundles or humble writings), emphasizing the importance of the tally.

C: 汉置四郡，断匈奴入羌之路：汉武帝时期在河西走廊设置酒泉、武威、张掖、敦煌四郡，阻断了匈奴与羌人的联系。出自《汉书·西域传》，这里指治理边疆的策略。
E: The Han established four commanderies, cutting off the Xiongnu's route to the Qiang: During Emperor Wu of Han's reign, the four commanderies of Jiuquan, Wuwei, Zhangye, and Dunhuang were established in the Hexi Corridor, blocking the connection between the Xiongnu and the Qiang people. From the "Book of Han · Treatise on the Western Regions". Here it refers to a strategy for governing the frontier.

C: 甘凉：指甘肃张掖（甘州）和武威（凉州），为古代西北边疆重镇。
E: Gan and Liang: Refers to Zhangye (Ganzhou) and Wuwei (Liangzhou) in Gansu, important towns on the ancient northwestern frontier.

C: 屯田建牙：屯田，指军队在边疆开垦土地耕种；建牙，指设立将军营帐，建立军事据点。
E: Tuntian and establishing headquarters: "Tuntian" means military agricultural colonies where soldiers farm land on the frontier; "establishing headquarters" means setting up the general's tent, establishing a military stronghold.

C: 生羌岁久防奸诈：生羌，指未归附的羌人部落。意为对长期未归附的羌人要防备其奸诈行为。
E: With the raw Qiang for years, guard against their deceit:
"Raw Qiang" refers to Qiang tribes that have not submitted. It means one must be wary of the deceitful behavior of Qiang people who have long remained unsubjugated.

C: 奈苦同甘，信赏必罚：指与士兵同甘共苦，奖赏分明、惩罚严格，是古代治军的重要原则。
E: Endure hardship and share sweetness, trustworthy rewards and
certain punishments: Means sharing both hardship and comfort with the soldiers, rewarding faithfully and punishing strictly. This is an important principle of ancient military management.

C: 信地：指军队驻守的固定地域。
E: Area of Responsibility: Refers to the fixed area guarded by an army.

C: 诸夷长：指边疆各少数民族的首领。
E: Chieftains of the various tribes: Refers to the leaders of the various minority tribes on the frontier.

C: 秦川雨，杜陵花：秦川，指陕西关中平原；杜陵，在今陕西西安东南，为汉宣帝陵墓所在地。代指中原家乡的美好景象。
E: Qinchuan rain, Duling flowers: "Qinchuan" refers to the Guanzhong Plain in Shaanxi; "Duling" is southeast of modern Xi'an, Shaanxi, the location of Emperor Xuan of Han's tomb. They represent the beautiful scenes of the Central Plains homeland.

C: 黄宣：指皇帝的诏书。
E: Yellow Proclamation: Refers to an imperial edict.

C: 团营：明代京军编制，这里代指朝廷的军队。
E: Regimental Camp: A Ming Dynasty military formation for capital troops. Here it represents the imperial army.

C: 细柳春风大将牙：细柳，指汉代周亚夫驻军的细柳营，以军纪严明著称。出自《史记·绛侯周勃世家》，这里用细柳营的典故形容军队纪律严明。

Willow Camp spring breeze, general's headquarters: "Willow Camp" (细柳营) refers to the camp where Zhou Yafu of the Han Dynasty was stationed, famous for strict military discipline. From "Records of the Grand Historian · Hereditary House of Zhou Bo, Marquis of Jiang". Here, the allusion to the Willow Camp is used to describe an army with strict discipline.
秦时明月汉时关：出自唐代王昌龄《出塞二首·其一》"秦时明月汉时关，万里长征人未还"。原句意思是依旧是秦汉时期的明月和边关，守边御敌鏖战万里征人未回还。
E: Moon of Qin times, pass of Han times: From Wang Changling's (Tang Dynasty) "On the Frontier, Two Poems, No. 1": "The moon of Qin and the pass of Han, ten thousand miles of Long March, people have not returned". The original line means the moon is still the moon of Qin times, the pass is still the pass of Han times; the soldiers who marched ten thousand miles to guard the frontier and fight the enemy have not returned.

C: 绣纛人看上将还：绣纛，指装饰华美的军旗。意为人们看着插着绣旗的上将凯旋归来。
E: People watch the embroidered banner, the general returns:
"Embroidered banner" refers to an ornate military flag. It means people watch the general under the embroidered banner returning victoriously.

C: 但使龙城飞将在，不教胡马度阴山：出自唐代王昌龄《出塞二首·其一》。原句意思是倘若龙城的飞将军李广如今还在，绝不许匈奴南下牧马度过阴山。
E: If only the Flying General of Dragon City were here, He would never let the Tartar horses cross the Yin Mountains: From Wang Changling's (Tang Dynasty) "On the Frontier, Two Poems, No. 1". The original line means if the Flying General (Li Guang) of Dragon City were still here today, he would never allow the Xiongnu horses to cross the Yin Mountains to the south.

C: 丛菊两开人不至，北书不寄雁无情：化用杜甫《秋兴八首·其一》"丛菊两开他日泪，孤舟一系故园心"。原句意思是丛菊两度盛开，又勾起往日的感伤泪水，孤舟长久系在岸边，牵动着对故园的思念。这里借"丛菊两开""北书不寄"表达久盼书信不至的失落。
E: Chrysanthemums have bloomed twice but the man hasn't arrived, no letter from the north, the wild geese are heartless: Adapted from Du Fu's "Autumn Meditations, Eight Poems, No. 1": "The double blossoms of the cluster of flowers will bring tears one day, and the lonely boat will tie the heart of the old garden". The original line means the chrysanthemums have bloomed twice, drawing forth tears of past days; the lone boat long tied up, tugs at the heart for
my old garden. Here, "chrysanthemums bloomed twice" and "no letter from the north" express the disappointment of long awaiting a letter that never comes.

C: 阳关哨卒：阳关，古关名，在今甘肃敦煌西南，是古代出塞要道。出自王维《送元二使安西》"西出阳关无故人"，这里指来自边塞的士兵。
E: Yang Pass sentry: Yang Pass, name of an ancient pass, southwest of modern Dunhuang, Gansu, was a key route out to the frontier. From Wang Wei's "Seeing Off Yuan Er on His Mission to Anxi": "West of Yang Pass you'll meet no more old friends". Here it refers to a soldier from the frontier.

C: 不上望京楼：望京楼，指遥望京城的楼阁，代指思念家乡或朝廷。这里指李参军未流露归乡之意。
E: Does not ascend the Gazing-at-the-Capital Tower: "Gazing-at-the-Capital Tower" refers to a tower from which one gazes towards the capital, representing longing for home or the court. Here it means Adjutant Li does not show any intention of returning home.

C: 红妆夜宴军中美：化用边塞诗中军营宴饮的场景，指军中的欢宴生活。
E: Ladies in red, night banquet, beauty in the army: Uses imagery from frontier poetry of banquets in army camps, referring to the festive banquet life in the army.

C: 千寻落叶离不的花根里：以落叶终究离不开花根，比喻人无论漂泊多远终究眷恋故土或亲人。
E: A thousand-fathom fallen leaf cannot leave the flower's root: Using the fallen leaf ultimately unable to leave the flower's root as a metaphor for a person's attachment to their native land or family no matter how far they wander.

C: 回雁峰前沙似雪，受降城外月如霜。不知何处吹芦管，一夜征人尽望乡：出自唐代李益《夜上受降城闻笛》。原句意思是回乐峰前的沙地像雪一样洁白，受降城外的月亮像霜一样寒冷。不知道从什么地方传来了吹芦管的声音，让整个晚上征人都在思念故乡。这里直接引用李益诗句，体现边塞征人的思乡之情。
E: Before Huiyan Peak the sand is like snow, outside the Shouxiang City the moon is like frost. I don't know where the reed pipe is being played, making all the soldiers gaze homeward all night long: From Li Yi's (Tang Dynasty) "Hearing a Flute on the Wall of Shouxiang City at Night". The original lines mean the sand before Huiyan Peak is like snow, the moon outside Shouxiang City is like frost. I don't know where the sound of the reed pipe is coming from, making all the soldiers look towards home all night. Here Li Yi's lines are directly quoted to express the homesickness of frontier soldiers.

C: 诗中有画，画中有诗：出自苏轼评价王维的话"味摩诘之诗，诗中有画；观摩诘之画，画中有诗"，指诗歌和绘画相互融合，意境优美。
E: There is painting in the poetry, and poetry in the painting: From Su Shi's evaluation of Wang Wei: "Savoring Mojie's [Wang Wei] poetry, there is painting in the poetry; viewing Mojie's painting, there is poetry in the painting." It means poetry and painting are fused together, creating a beautiful artistic conception.

C: 阳关：古关名，在今甘肃敦煌西南。王维《送元二使安西》有"劝君更尽一杯酒，西出阳关无故人"，这里代指边塞。
E: Yang Pass: Name of an ancient pass, southwest of modern Dunhuang, Gansu. Wang Wei's "Seeing Off Yuan Er on His Mission to Anxi" contains the line: "I urge you to drink one more cup of wine; West of Yang Pass you'll meet no more old friends." Here it represents the frontier.

C: 潇湘：指潇水和湘水，多代指江南水乡或思念之地，与边塞的荒凉形成对比。
E: Xiao and Xiang: Refers to the Xiao and Xiang rivers, often used to represent the Jiangnan water country or a place of longing, contrasting with the desolation of the frontier.

C: 河西：指黄河以西的地区，古代常为边疆征战之地，这里代指李参军所在的边塞。
E: Hexi: Refers to the area west of the Yellow River, often a place of frontier warfare in ancient times. Here it represents the frontier where Adjutant Li is stationed.

C: 金谷田园：金谷，指西晋石崇的金谷园，是古代著名园林，代指富贵家园。这里指家中田园产业。
E: Jingu Gardens and Fields: "Jingu" refers to Shi Chong's (Western Jin Dynasty) Jingu Garden, a famous ancient garden, representing a wealthy home. Here it refers to the family's estate and fields.

C: 旧家门户：指家族的家业、门第。
E: Old family's household: Refers to the family's property and social status.

C: 莲叶寒塘秋照里：化用李清照《声声慢》"寒塘渡鹤影，冷月葬花魂"等秋景意象，描绘秋日荷塘的凄清景象。
E: Lotus leaves in a cold pond under autumn light: Uses autumnal imagery like that in Li Qingzhao's "Sheng Sheng Man" ("Slow Slow Song") – "a lone shadow crosses the cold pond", "cold moon buries the flower's soul" – to depict the desolate scene of an autumn lotus pond.

C: 连天衰草砧声起：砧声，指捣衣声，古代常用来象征思妇对征人的思念。出自李白《子夜吴歌·秋歌》"长安一片月，万户捣衣声"，这里以衰草、砧声描绘秋日思亲的凄凉氛围。
E: Endless withered grass, the sound of fulling blocks arises: "Sound of fulling blocks" refers to the sound of clothes being beaten clean (often by women missing their absent husbands), a common symbol in ancient poetry for a wife's longing for her soldier husband. From Li Bai's "Midnight Songs · Autumn Song": "Over Chang'an a stretch of moon, in ten thousand households the sound of fulling blocks." Here, withered grass and the sound of fulling blocks depict the bleak atmosphere of missing loved ones in autumn.

C: 锦绣团栾：指家人团聚，生活美好，锦绣象征美好，团栾指团圆。
E: Brocade and embroidery, family reunion: Refers to family reunion and a good life. "Brocade and embroidery" symbolize beauty and wealth; "family reunion" means gathering together.

C: 洛阳才子：指有才华的文人，洛阳为古代文化名城，多出才子。东汉班固《两都赋》称洛阳"英俊之域，绂冕所兴"，后常用"洛阳才子"代指有才之士。文中指李益，因洛阳多出有才之士，此处以"洛阳才子"称李益，突出其文才出众。
E: Luoyang Talent: Refers to a talented scholar. Luoyang was a famous ancient cultural city that produced many talents. Ban Gu's (Eastern Han) "Rhapsody on the Two Capitals" called Luoyang "a region of outstanding talent, where official caps arise." Later, "Luoyang Talent" was often used to refer to talented scholars. In the text, it refers to Li Yi. Since Luoyang produced many talents, calling Li Yi a "Luoyang Talent" highlights his outstanding literary ability.

C: 十朱轮：朱轮，古代高官所乘车子的车轮涂成朱红色，代指高官。"十朱轮"形容家族中高官众多，权势显赫。文中形容卢太尉家族权势显赫，家中高官众多，以"十朱轮"体现家族的富贵与地位。
E: Ten Vermilion Wheels: "Vermilion wheels" refer to the red-painted wheels of carriages used by high officials, representing high rank. "Ten vermilion wheels" describes a family with many high officials, powerful and influential. In the text, it describes Marshal Lu's family's prominence, with many high-ranking officials, using "ten vermilion wheels" to reflect the family's wealth and status.

C: 秉大钧：大钧，指国家政务重任。秉大钧意为掌握国家重要权力。文中指卢太尉兄弟掌握国家重要政务权力，强调其在朝廷中的重要地位。
E: Wield the Great Balance: "Great Balance" refers to the heavy responsibility of state affairs. "Wield the Great Balance" means to hold important state power. In the text, it refers to Marshal Lu and his brothers wielding important state power, emphasizing their important position in the court.

C: 河阳征战净：河阳，古地名，今河南孟州，历史上常为战场。"征战净"指平定战乱。文中指卢太尉镇守孟门关外，平定当地战乱，使河阳一带战事平息。
E: Heyang campaigns pacified: "Heyang" is an ancient place name, modern Mengzhou, Henan, often a battlefield in history. "Campaigns pacified" means quelling the turmoil of war. In the text, it means Marshal Lu garrisoned outside Mengmen Pass and pacified the local conflicts, bringing peace to the Heyang area.

C: 开阁引词人：开阁，指打开府门；词人，指有才华的文人。意为广纳文人贤才。文中指卢太尉打开府门，广纳像李益这样有才华的文人参与军事，体现其招揽贤才的举动。
E: Open the pavilion to attract literary men: "Open the pavilion" means to open the mansion gates; "literary men" refers to talented scholars. It means to widely recruit scholarly talents. In the text, it means Marshal Lu opened his mansion gates to widely recruit talented scholars like Li Yi to participate in military affairs, reflecting his action of recruiting worthies.

C: 走马到任：指官员骑马快速前往任职地点，形容赴任迅速。文中指李益骑马快速前往孟门关，到卢太尉军中任职，表现赴任的迅速。
E: Ride quickly to assume office: Means an official rides quickly to his post, describing a swift assumption of duty. In the text, it means Li Yi rode quickly to Mengmen Pass to take up his post in Marshal Lu's army, showing the speed of his arrival.

C: 万金家报：指珍贵的家信，"万金"形容家信的珍贵。文中指李益收到的家信十分珍贵，"万金"凸显家信在边塞征战背景下的重要性与难得。
E: Ten-thousand-gold family message: Refers to a precious family letter; "ten thousand gold" describes the letter's preciousness. In the text, it means the family letter Li Yi received was extremely precious; "ten thousand gold" highlights the importance and rarity of a family letter in the context of frontier warfare.

C: 飞雁传书：化用"雁足传书"典故，《汉书·苏武传》记载大雁传递书信，后以飞雁代指传递家信的使者。文中借"飞雁"代指王哨儿传递家信，呼应古代雁足传书的典故，指通过使者传递平安消息。
E: Flying goose delivers a letter: Adapts the "message on a goose's foot" allusion. The "Book of Han · Biography of Su Wu" records a goose delivering a letter. Later, a flying goose came to represent a messenger delivering family letters. In the text, "flying goose" represents Wang Shao'er delivering the family letter, echoing the ancient goose-foot message allusion, meaning sending news of safety via a messenger.

C: 吹笙院：指女子居住的庭院，笙为古代乐器，常与女子生活场景相关，这里代指家中妻室。文中代指李益家中妻室所在的庭院，表达李益对家中妻子的思念与牵挂。
E: Sheng-blowing courtyard: Refers to the courtyard where women reside. The "sheng" is an ancient instrument often associated with women's living quarters. Here it represents the home and wife. In the text, it represents the courtyard of Li Yi's wife, expressing Li Yi's longing and concern for his wife at home.

C: 登坛：古代指将领登上坛台接受任命，代指担任重要军职。文中指卢太尉作为大将担任重要军职，在军中拥有崇高地位。
E: Ascend the altar: In ancient times, it meant a general ascending an altar to receive an appointment, representing assuming an important military post. In the text, it means Marshal Lu, as a general, holds an important military post and has a lofty position in the army.

C: 尺五天：指离天很近，形容地位尊贵，距离朝廷不远。文中形容孟门关虽在边塞，但离朝廷不远，也暗示卢太尉地位尊贵，接近权力中心。
E: Five feet from heaven: Means very close to heaven, describing a noble status and proximity to the court. In the text, it describes Mengmen Pass as being on the frontier but not far from the court, also hinting at Marshal Lu's noble status and proximity to the center of power.

C: 词锋八面：形容文辞犀利，能应对各方言辞。文中形容李益文辞犀利，能在军事事务中以文才应对各方情况，凸显其文才在军中的作用。
E: Literary prowess in all directions: Describes sharp and incisive writing, able to handle arguments from all sides. In the text, it describes Li Yi's sharp writing, able to use his literary talent to handle various situations in military affairs, highlighting the role of his literary talent in the army.

C: 笔花梢惯扫狼烟：笔花梢，指文才；狼烟，指边塞战事。意为以文才参与军事，平定战乱。文中指李益以文才参与军事事务，如同用笔墨平定边塞战事，体现其以文从武的经历。
E: Brush-tip flowers accustomed to sweeping away wolf-smoke: "Brush-tip flowers" refers to literary talent; "wolf-smoke" refers to frontier warfare. It means participating in military affairs with literary talent to quell rebellion. In the text, it means Li Yi participates in military affairs with his literary talent, as if using brush and ink to pacify frontier conflicts, reflecting his experience of serving in the military through literary means.

C: 相如喻檄：相如，指司马相如，汉武帝时他作《喻巴蜀檄》安抚百姓。指以文辞晓谕事理。文中借司马相如作檄文安抚百姓的典故，指李益以文辞参与军中事务，晓谕事理。
E: Xiangru's persuasive proclamation: "Xiangru" refers to Sima Xiangru. During Emperor Wu of Han's reign, he wrote the "Proclamation to Ba and Shu" to pacify the people. It means using writing to explain matters clearly. In the text, the allusion to Sima Xiangru writing a proclamation to pacify the people refers to Li Yi using his writing to participate in military affairs and explain matters.

C: 终军乘传：终军，西汉辩士，曾乘驿车出使南越。指年轻有为，奉命出使。文中借终军乘驿车出使的典故，类比李益年轻有为，奉命来到卢太尉军中任职。
E: Zhongjun riding the relay carriage: "Zhongjun" refers to Zhong Jun, a rhetorician of the Western Han Dynasty who rode a relay carriage on a mission to Nanyue. It means being young and promising, sent on a mission. In the text, the allusion to Zhongjun riding a relay carriage on a mission is used to analogize Li Yi being young and promising, sent to serve in Marshal Lu's army.

C: 蓬转：如蓬草随风飘转，比喻漂泊不定。文中形容李益的漂泊状态，从西域到河阳，如蓬草飘转，体现其任职地点的变动与漂泊感。
E: Tumbleweed turning: Like tumbleweed blown by the wind, a metaphor for drifting uncertainly. In the text, it describes Li Yi's drifting state, from the Western Regions to Heyang, like tumbleweed blowing, reflecting the changes in his postings and his sense of rootlessness.

C: 不上望京楼：出自李益诗句，这里指不流露思乡之情。文中卢太尉提及李益此句，李益称是"醉后余谈"，实则暗含其压抑的思乡之情，怕流露后影响军中事务。
E: Does not ascend the Gazing-at-the-Capital Tower: From a line by Li Yi. Here it means not showing feelings of homesickness. In the text, Marshal Lu mentions this line of Li Yi's; Li Yi calls it "drunken talk," but it actually contains his suppressed homesickness, fearing that showing it would affect military affairs.

C: 赋河清鲍照：鲍照，南朝文学家，曾作《河清颂》赞美太平。指有文学才华，歌颂盛世。文中借鲍照作《河清颂》的典故，夸赞李益有文学才华，可在军中展现文才，也暗示对其归顺自己的期许。
E: Compose a "Ode to the Clear River" like Bao Zhao: Bao Zhao, a Southern Dynasties writer, once wrote the "Ode to the Clear River" praising peace. It means having literary talent to eulogize a prosperous age. In the text, the allusion to Bao Zhao writing the "Ode to the Clear River" is used to praise Li Yi's literary talent, which can be displayed in the army, also hinting at the expectation for him to submit to Marshal Lu.

C: 登楼王粲：王粲，东汉文学家，作《登楼赋》抒发思乡与怀才不遇之情。这里借王粲指文人在军中的情怀。文中借王粲登楼思乡的典故，暗指李益在军中虽有才华却可能心怀思乡之情。
E: Wang Can ascending the tower: Wang Can, an Eastern Han writer, wrote "Rhapsody on Climbing the Tower" expressing homesickness and frustration at unrecognized talent. Here, Wang Can represents the feelings of a scholar in the army. In the text, the allusion to Wang Can ascending the tower and longing for home subtly suggests that Li Yi, though talented in the army, might harbor feelings of homesickness.

C: 禁庭清选：指在朝廷中被精心选拔任用。文中指卢太尉暗示李益若归顺自己，未来可在朝廷中被精心选拔任用，有光明仕途。
E: Pure selection for the forbidden court: Refers to being carefully selected for appointment in the imperial court. In the text, Marshal Lu hints that if Li Yi submits to him, he could be carefully selected for appointment in the court in the future, having a bright official career.

C: 贵易妻：出自《史记·陈丞相世家》"臣闻易妻者，士之常情"，指人显贵后更换妻子。文中卢太尉以此劝说李益在显贵后更换妻子，试图让其抛弃前妻，另结豪门以谋进身，体现其功利心态。
E: Wealth changes wives: From "Records of the Grand Historian · Hereditary House of Chancellor Chen": "Your servant has heard that changing wives is the common sentiment of scholars." It means a man changes his wife after becoming wealthy and powerful. In the text, Marshal Lu uses this to persuade Li Yi to change his wife after gaining prominence, trying to make him abandon his former wife and marry into a powerful family to advance himself, revealing his utilitarian mindset.

C: 晚风砧杵：砧杵，捣衣的工具，傍晚捣衣声常象征思妇对征人的思念。文中借傍晚捣衣声的意象，暗示李益对家中妻子的思念，砧杵声常关联思妇盼归之情。
E: Evening wind, fulling block and pestle: "Fulling block and pestle" are tools for beating clothes clean. The sound of fulling in the evening often symbolizes a wife's longing for her absent soldier husband. In the text, the imagery of the evening fulling sound suggests Li Yi's longing for his wife at home; the sound is often associated with a wife's hope for her husband's return.

C: 夜月刀环：刀环，刀柄上的环，"环"与"还"谐音，代指思念归乡。文中以"刀环"谐音"归还"，借夜月与刀环的意象，表达李益对归乡与团聚的渴望。
E: Night moon, sword ring: "Sword ring" is the ring on the sword hilt. "Ring" is a homophone for "return" , representing the desire to return home. In the text, the homophone "sword ring" for "return" is used, along with the imagery of the night moon and sword ring, to express Li Yi's longing to return home and reunite.

C: 归燕、征雁：燕和雁均为候鸟，常用来象征归乡之情，归燕指归来的燕子，征雁指迁徙的大雁。文中以归燕、征雁象征归乡之情，体现李益在军中对家乡和亲人的思念，以及对团聚的期盼。
E: Returning swallows, migrating wild geese: Both swallows and wild geese are migratory birds, often used to symbolize the desire to return home. "Returning swallows" are swallows coming back; "migrating wild geese" are geese on the move. In the text, returning swallows and migrating wild geese symbolize the desire to return home, reflecting Li Yi's longing for his hometown and family while in the army, and his hope for reunion.

C: 关河别怨：指因山河阻隔而产生的离别思念之情。文中指李益因山河阻隔与家人分离，由此产生的离别思念之情，凸显其思乡之切。
E: Sorrow of separation at passes and rivers: Refers to the sorrow of separation and longing caused by the barrier of mountains and rivers. In the text, it refers to the sorrow of separation and longing Li Yi feels due to being separated from his family by mountains and rivers, highlighting the intensity of his homesickness.

C: 文武朝班：指朝廷中文武官员的行列，代指在朝廷任职。文中指卢太尉与李益期待未来能进入朝廷文武官员行列，在京城任职，体现对仕途的追求。
E: Civil and military court ranks: Refers to the ranks of civil and military officials at court, representing holding office in the capital. In the text, it means Marshal Lu and Li Yi look forward to entering the ranks of court officials in the future, serving in the capital, reflecting their pursuit of official careers.

C: 汉苑：指汉代宫苑，代指朝廷、京城。文中代指朝廷和京城，表达对回到中央任职、跻身权力中心的向往。
E: Han Park: Refers to the Han Dynasty palace parks, representing the court and capital. In the text, it represents the court and capital, expressing the desire to return to a central post and join the center of power.

C: 鬼蜮含沙影：化用"含沙射影"典故，《诗经·小雅·何人斯》"为鬼为蜮，则不可得"，后以鬼蜮含沙比喻暗中害人。文中暗指卢太尉设下圈套陷害李益，如同暗中害人的鬼蜮，体现其阴险用心。
E: Demons and miasmas containing sand shadows: Adapts the "shoot sand from the shadows" allusion. The "Classic of Poetry · Minor Odes · What Man Is This" has "If he be a ghost or a miasma, then he cannot be caught." Later, "demons and miasmas containing sand" became a metaphor for harming people secretly. In the text, it subtly refers to Marshal Lu setting a trap to harm Li Yi, like a demon harming people secretly, revealing his sinister intention.

C: 蛟龙上钓钩：比喻有才能的人落入他人设下的圈套。文中比喻李益这一有才华的人落入卢太尉设下的圈套，暗示李益将面临困境。
E: A flood dragon on the fishing hook: A metaphor for a talented person falling into a trap set by others. In the text, it metaphorically means Li Yi, a talented man, falls into the trap set by Marshal Lu, hinting that Li Yi will face difficulties.

C: 阳台雨过：阳台，出自战国楚宋玉《高唐赋》"旦为朝云，暮为行雨，朝朝暮暮，阳台之下"，指男女欢会之所。文中指往昔情爱场景已过，呼应"翠馆云闲"的寂寥。
E: Rain passes over the Sunny Terrace: "Sunny Terrace" comes from Song Yu's (Warring States, Chu) "Rhapsody on Gaotang": "At dawn she is the morning cloud, at dusk the driving rain; morning and evening, beneath the Sunny Terrace." It refers to a place of romantic encounter. In the text, it means the scenes of past love have passed, echoing the loneliness of "green lodge, clouds idle."

C: 梧桐金井：金井，指装饰华美的井，梧桐常与秋雨、愁绪关联。出自温庭筠《更漏子》"梧桐树，三更雨，不道离情正苦"，文中以梧桐金井的秋景烘托独坐闲愁。
E: Wutong trees by the golden well: "Golden well" refers to an ornately decorated well. Wutong trees are often associated with autumn rain and sorrow. From Wen Tingyun's "Geng Lou Zi" (Water Clock Draining): "Wutong trees, third-watch rain, unaware the sorrow of parting is so bitter." In the text, the autumn scene of wutong trees and the golden well sets the mood for sitting alone with idle sorrow.

C: 五陵年少：五陵，指汉代长安附近五帝陵墓，为豪富聚居地；年少，指富家子弟。出自杜甫《饮中八仙歌》"五陵年少争缠头，一曲红绡不知数"，文中指鲍四娘青楼时陪伴的富家子弟。
E: Young masters of the Five Mausoleums: "Five Mausoleums" refer to the five imperial mausoleums near Chang'an in the Han Dynasty, where the wealthy lived; "young masters" refers to sons of rich families. From Du Fu's "Song of the Eight Immortals of the Wine Cup": "Young men from the Five Mausoleums compete to give headdress gifts; for one song, countless red silks." In the text, it refers to the young rich men Bao Siniang accompanied in her brothel days.

C: 秋蛩度枕：秋蛩，即秋蝉，秋蝉鸣声常添秋夜凄凉。文中指秋蝉鸣声从枕边传来，加剧愁绪。
E: Autumn crickets pass the pillow: "Autumn crickets" are autumn cicadas; their chirping often adds to the desolation of an autumn night. In the text, it means the sound of autumn crickets comes from beside the pillow, intensifying the sorrow.

C: 团扇暗消磨：团扇，出自班婕妤《怨歌行》"裁为合欢扇，团团似明月。常恐秋节至，凉意夺炎热"，以团扇秋来被弃喻女子失宠。文中指团扇随秋光渐凉而被闲置，暗写时光流逝与心绪落寞。
E: Round fan secretly wanes: "Round fan" comes from Ban Jieyu's "Song of Resentment": "Fashioned into a lovers' fan, round like the bright moon. Often fearing the autumn season will arrive, the coolness will seize the heat." The round fan being discarded in autumn metaphorically represents a woman falling out of favor. In the text, it means the round fan is set aside as the autumn light grows cool, subtly writing about the passage of time and despondent mood.

C: 芭蕉夜雨：出自李商隐《夜雨寄北》"何当共剪西窗烛，却话巴山夜雨时"，芭蕉夜雨常为愁思意象。文中指夜雨打芭蕉的声音在闲时听来更显聒噪，增添烦忧。
E: Banana leaves, night rain: From Li Shangyin's "Night Rain: Sent North": "When shall we together trim the candle by the west window, And talk about this night rain on Mount Ba?" Banana leaves and night rain are often images of sorrowful thought. In the text, it means the sound of night rain on banana leaves seems even more clamorous when heard idly, adding to the worry.

C: 捞酒客、拗花人：捞酒客指为酒而来的人，拗花人指折花之人，均为市井俗语。文中王哨儿自嘲身份，掩饰真实目的。
E: Wine-scooping guest, flower-plucking man: "Wine-scooping guest" refers to someone who comes for wine; "flower-plucking man" refers to someone who breaks off flowers. Both are common colloquial terms. In the text, Wang Shao'er uses these to mock his own status and conceal his real purpose.

C: 呆打孩：宋元口语，指发呆、懵懂的样子。文中指佳人命薄，常为情事发呆伤感。
E: Dull and dazed: Song and Yuan Dynasty colloquialism, meaning in a daze. In the text, it means the beauty's fate is hard, often dazed and saddened by matters of love.

C: 敲才：宋元口语，指该死的人，含责骂意。文中鲍四娘痛骂李益负心，称其为"敲才"。
E: Knock-worthy talent: Song and Yuan Dynasty colloquialism, meaning someone who deserves a knock (beating), i.e., a damnable person, with a scolding tone. In the text, Bao Siniang bitterly scolds Li Yi for being unfaithful, calling him "knock-worthy talent."

C: 团弄：指设法哄骗、应付。文中鲍四娘让王哨儿将消息委婉传达，避免直接刺激小玉。
E: Coax and handle: Means to try to coax and manage a situation. In the text, Bao Siniang tells Wang Shao'er to convey the message tactfully to avoid directly upsetting Xiaoyu.

C: 秋风远信雁鸿低：雁鸿低飞常象征远方书信将至。文中以秋风中低飞的雁鸿，暗示远方消息传来却非佳音。
E: Autumn wind, distant message, wild geese fly low: Wild geese flying low often symbolize a distant letter arriving. In the text, the wild geese flying low in the autumn wind suggest that a distant message is coming, but it is not good news.

C: 雪隐鹭鹚飞始见，柳藏鹦鹉语方知：化用唐诗意象，指真相如鹭鹚隐于雪、鹦鹉藏于柳，需行动或言语才显露。文中指李益招赘的消息终将被小玉知晓。
E: The egret hidden in snow is seen only when it flies, the parrot hidden in willow is known only when it speaks: Uses Tang poetry imagery meaning the truth is like an egret hidden in snow or a parrot hidden in willow, only revealed through action or speech. In the text, it means the news of Li Yi's impending marriage into another family will eventually become known to Xiaoyu.

C: 寒鬓宝钗犹挂，倚秋窗数点黄花：黄花，即菊花，常象征秋日寂寥与高洁。文中旦（小玉）秋窗倚立，鬓边宝钗未卸，凝望菊花，烘托其孤独思念之情。
E: Cold temples, precious hairpin still hangs, leaning by the autumn window counting a few yellow flowers: "Yellow flowers" are chrysanthemums, often symbolizing autumn loneliness and nobility. In the text, Dan (Xiaoyu) leans by the autumn window, her precious hairpin still in her hair, gazing at the chrysanthemums, enhancing the atmosphere of her loneliness and longing.

C: 扶头酒醒炉香灺：扶头酒，指易醉的酒；炉香灺，指炉中香燃尽成灰。出自李清照《声声慢》"三杯两盏淡酒，怎敌他、晚来风急"，文中写小玉借酒消愁，酒醒后炉香已灭，更添凄清。
E: Head-spinning wine awakens, stove incense turns to ash: "Head-spinning wine" refers to strong, easily intoxicating wine; "stove incense turns to ash" means the incense in the burner has burned to ashes. From Li Qingzhao's "Sheng Sheng Man": "Three cups, two weak cups of light wine, how can they withstand the swift evening wind?" In the text, it describes Xiaoyu drowning her sorrows in wine; after she awakens, the incense has burned out, adding to the desolation.

C: 柳晕斜：柳晕，指女子眉妆如柳叶般晕染；斜，指妆残。文中形容小玉因落泪而眉妆散乱，显其憔悴。
E: Willow halo slants: "Willow halo" refers to a woman's eyebrow makeup blurred like willow leaves; "slants" means the makeup is smudged. In the text, it describes Xiaoyu's eyebrow makeup being smudged from crying, showing her distress.

C: 秋风满院无人见，怕到黄昏独倚门：化用唐代白居易《秋雨夜眠》"晓晴寒未起，霜叶满阶红"等秋夜孤寂意象，文中写小玉盼鲍四娘不至，黄昏独倚门的落寞。
E: Autumn wind fills the courtyard, no one sees, afraid of dusk, alone leaning by the door: Uses imagery of autumn night loneliness like that in Bai Juyi's (Tang) "Sleeping on an Autumn Rainy Night" – "Dawn clears, cold, not yet risen, frosty leaves redden the steps." In the text, it describes Xiaoyu hoping in vain for Bao Siniang to come, lonely and leaning by the door at dusk.

C: 谪仙才：谪仙，指李白，喻才华出众如谪居人间的仙人。文中小玉猜测李益或许因才华被朝廷重用。
E: Banished Immortal talent: "Banished Immortal" refers to Li Bai, metaphorically meaning talent so outstanding it's like an immortal banished to earth. In the text, Xiaoyu speculates that Li Yi might be heavily employed by the court due to his talent.

C: 洛阳侯金印挂：洛阳侯，指古代在洛阳封爵的诸侯，金印为侯王印信。文中小玉希望李益立功封爵，挂印归来。
E: Luoyang Marquis hangs his gold seal: "Luoyang Marquis" refers to a feudal lord enfeoffed in Luoyang in ancient times; a gold seal is the marquis's seal. In the text, Xiaoyu hopes Li Yi will achieve merit, be enfeoffed as a marquis, and return wearing his seal.

C: 虎头牌：古代军中令牌，上刻虎头，用以调兵。文中指李益可能持令牌途经秦关驿。
E: Tiger-head tally: An ancient military token engraved with a tiger's head, used to mobilize troops. In the text, it means Li Yi might be passing through Qinguan Post Station holding such a tally.

C: 凤尾旗：装饰有凤尾的军旗，象征军队威严。文中指李益随军出行，军旗紧随。
E: Phoenix-tail banner: A military banner decorated with phoenix tails, symbolizing army majesty. In the text, it means Li Yi is traveling with the army, the banners following closely.

C: 俊参军功级多，小县君封号加：参军，李益官职；县君，古代对妇女的封号。文中小玉期盼李益立功升官，自己也能获封号。
E: Handsome Adjutant has many merits and ranks, the little County Lady receives an added title: "Adjutant" is Li Yi's official title; "County Lady" is an ancient title for women. In the text, Xiaoyu hopes Li Yi will achieve merit and get promoted, and that she will also receive a title.

C: 拄倒了昆仑北海涯：昆仑、北海，指极远之地，喻李益威风震慑远方。文中鲍四娘先假意说李益或有显赫战功。
E: Propped up Kunlun, toppled the North Sea's edge: Kunlun and North Sea refer to extremely distant places, metaphorically meaning Li Yi's awe inspires fear in distant lands. In the text, Bao Siniang first falsely says Li Yi might have glorious military achievements.

C: 喧动了长安西日下：长安，京城，喻李益凯旋消息轰动京城。文中鲍四娘虚说李益可能声名远播。
E: Stirred up Chang'an under the western sun: Chang'an, the capital, metaphorically means news of Li Yi's victory stirs up the capital. In the text, Bao Siniang fictitiously says Li Yi might be famous far and wide.

C: 觅封侯时运底有甚巧争差：封侯，指建功立业；争差，指波折。文中鲍四娘暗示李益仕途或有变故。
E: Seeking to become a marquis, what clever twists and turns does fate hold at bottom?: "Becoming a marquis" means achieving merit and establishing oneself; "twists and turns" means setbacks. In the text, Bao Siniang hints that Li Yi's official career might have unexpected changes.

C: 做官儿不着家，做县君乔坐衙：乔坐衙，指女子空守闺房如官员坐堂却无事。文中鲍四娘点出李益未归，小玉空等。
