The King uses this to lament the change in the state's momentum.

春秋丧师，责在大夫：出自《春秋》及其相关注解中体现的战争责任观念。原句意思是在战争中损失军队，责任在于领兵的大夫。国王引用此句，认为驸马应对战事失利负责。
Losing an army in the Spring and Autumn [Annals], the responsibility lies with the great officer: Reflects the concept of responsibility for war from the "Spring and Autumn Annals" and its commentaries. The original means if an army is lost in war, the responsibility lies with the commanding great officer. The King quotes this, holding the Consort responsible for the military defeat.

淳郎：指淳于棼。这里是右相提及田子华可以代替淳于棼担任南柯太守时的称呼。
Chun Lang: Refers to Chunyu Fen. Here it is the Right Minister's call for him when suggesting Tian Zihua could replace him as Governor of Nanke.

杜宇啼红：杜宇即杜鹃鸟，传说蜀帝杜宇死后化为杜鹃，啼声哀切，至血出乃止。"对杜宇啼红"中以杜鹃啼血的意象，渲染悲伤的氛围，呼应生离死别的情境。
Cuckoo crying red: Cuckoo (Duyu) is the cuckoo bird;It is said that Emperor Duyu of Shu turned into a cuckoo after death, its cry is sorrowful, even to the point of bleeding. "Facing the cuckoo crying red" uses the image of the cuckoo crying blood to intensify the sorrowful atmosphere, echoing the situation of parting in life or death.

凤楼：指宫中楼阁，常代指后妃所居之处，也可泛指华丽的楼阁。"只愿的凤楼人永"中"凤楼人"指公主，表达希望公主平安长寿的心愿。
Phoenix Tower: Refers to palace towers, often representing the quarters of imperial consorts, or generally magnificent towers. In the line "only wish the Phoenix Tower person forever", "Phoenix Tower person" means the princess, expressing the wish for her safety and longevity.

乘龙：出自《太平广记》引《裴子语林》，相传秦穆公女弄玉嫁与善吹箫的萧史，后两人乘龙凤飞升。"断魂一缕，分付乘龙"中"乘龙"代指驸马，公主借此表达自己的魂魄愿追随驸马。
Ride the dragon: From the "Taiping Guangji" quoting the "Peizi Yulin";It is said that Duke Mu of Qin's daughter Nongyu married the skilled flute player Xiao Shi, and later they rode a dragon and phoenix and ascended. In the line "a wisp of broken soul, entrust to the dragon rider", "dragon rider" represents the Consort; the princess expresses her soul's desire to follow him.

皇华馆：古代接待使节或朝官的馆舍。"且请皇华馆筵宴"指请传旨的使者到皇华馆赴宴。
Imperial Splendor Hostel: An ancient hostel for receiving envoys or court officials. The line "and please feast at the Imperial Splendor Hostel" means inviting the edict-bearing envoy to a banquet at the hostel.

人生如传舍：传舍是古代供行人休息住宿的处所，"人生如传舍"意思是人生短暂，如同在旅舍中暂住一般，生以此感叹世事变迁、聚散无常。
Life is like a relay station: A relay station was an ancient place for travelers to rest; "life is like a relay station" means life is brief, like a temporary stay at an inn; the character uses this to lament the changes of the world and the impermanence of meetings and partings.

金枝玉叶：原指帝王的子孙后代，后泛指身份高贵的女子。"金枝玉叶病委蕤"中用来称呼公主，点明其尊贵身份。
Golden bough and jade leaf: Originally referred to the descendants of emperors; later generally meant women of noble status. Used in the line "golden bough and jade leaf, illness drooping" to address the princess, indicating her honorable status.

廿载南柯寄一枝："南柯"出自《南柯太守传》，代指淳于棼在南柯郡的官职与生活，"寄一枝"化用"鹪鹩巢于深林，不过一枝"，意为在南柯郡暂且安身二十载。
Twenty years in Nanke, lodging a single branch: "Nanke" comes from "The Governor of Nanke", representing Chunyu Fen's office and life in Nanke Prefecture; "lodging a single branch" adapts the phrase "the wren nesting in the deep forest needs but one branch", meaning dwelling temporarily in Nanke for twenty years.

攀留：指百姓挽留政绩卓著的官员，是古代对贤官的常见挽留方式。这里"衔恩赤子要追攀"指南柯百姓挽留淳于棼。
Clinging and detaining: Means the common people clinging to and detaining an official with outstanding achievements, a common way to urge a good official to stay in ancient times. Here, "grateful common people wish to pursue and cling" means the people of Nanke wish to detain Chunyu Fen.

棠阴满：典出《诗经·召南·甘棠》，召公曾在甘棠树下理政，后以"棠阴"喻指官吏的善政与遗爱。这里"喜南柯一郡棠阴满"赞淳于棼在南柯的德政。
Shade of the pear tree abundant:From "Classic of Poetry: Odes of Zhao: Sweet Pear Tree". The Duke of Shao once governed under a sweet pear tree; later "shade of the pear tree" came to metaphorically mean an official's benevolent governance and lasting love. Here, "rejoice Nanke, the whole prefecture full of pear tree shade" praises Chunyu Fen's virtuous governance in Nanke.

黄堂：古代地方长官的厅堂，这里"俺旧黄堂政事新人管"指淳于棼将南柯政务交予田子华。
Yellow Hall: The hall of an ancient local governor. Here, "my old Yellow Hall's affairs are managed by a new person" means Chunyu Fen hands over the administration of Nanke to Tian Zihua.

借寇长安：典出《后汉书·寇恂传》，寇恂政绩卓著，百姓请求借其留任一年，后以"借寇"指挽留贤官。这里"待俺借寇长安"指百姓希望淳于棼留任南柯。
Borrow Kou for Chang'an:From "Book of the Later Han: Biography of Kou Xun". Kou Xun had outstanding administrative achievements; the people requested to "borrow" him to stay one more year; later "borrow Kou" came to mean detaining a worthy official. Here, "wait for me to borrow Kou for Chang'an" means the people hope Chunyu Fen will remain in Nanke.

生祠：古代百姓为纪念有功德的官员而建的祠堂，供其在世时受祭祀。这里"只早晚生祠中跪祝赞"指百姓将在生祠中祈祷淳于棼。
Life-time shrine: Shrines built by the common people in ancient times to commemorate virtuous officials, where they were worshipped while still alive. Here, "only morning and evening, kneeling in the life-time shrine to pray and praise" means the people will pray for Chunyu Fen in the shrine.

薨：古代称诸侯或有爵位的大官死去，这里"公主薨了"指公主去世。
Passed away: An ancient term for the death of a feudal lord or high-ranking titled official. Here, "the princess has passed away" means the princess has died.

金枝：原指皇族子孙，这里"生长金枝岁月深"指公主出身皇族。
Golden bough: Originally means imperial descendants. Here, "grown a golden bough, years deep" means the princess was born into the imperial family.

紫禁：指皇宫，因宫墙多为紫色，故称。这里"归迟紫禁"指担心公主迟迟未回皇宫。
Forbidden City: Refers to the imperial palace, because its walls were often purple. Here, "returning late to the Forbidden City" means worrying that the princess is delayed in returning to the palace.

槐殿：指南柯郡相关的宫殿，因南柯故事与槐树有关，故称。这里"槐殿暗伤心"指在南柯的宫殿中暗自伤心。
Locust Hall: Refers to the palace related to Nanke Prefecture, named because of the locust tree connection in the Nanke story. Here, "Locust Hall, secretly heartbroken" means being secretly heartbroken in the Nanke palace.

青鸟：神话中为西王母传递消息的神鸟，后常代指信使。这里"青鸟能传喜"指信使能带来好消息。
Blue bird: In mythology, the bird that carried messages for the Queen Mother of the West; later often represented a messenger. Here, "the blue bird can convey joy" means a messenger can bring good news.

慈乌：即乌鸦，传说乌鸦能反哺，故常用来比喻子女孝顺，这里"慈乌怎报凶"指难以传递坏消息。
Pious crow: I.e., crow;It is said that crows practice filial piety (feed their parents), so often used metaphorically for filial children; here "how can the pious crow report evil?" means it's difficult to convey bad news.

皇华公馆：古代官方设立的驿站或公馆，供出差官员住宿。这里"离南柯卒于皇华公馆"指公主在皇华公馆去世。
Imperial Splendor Hostel: An officially established post house or hostel in ancient times for traveling officials to stay. Here, "left Nanke and died at the Imperial Splendor Hostel" means the princess died at the hostel.

凤将雏：指凤凰带着幼雏，比喻母亲对子女的呵护。这里"当日个凤将雏，你巧笑禁"指昔日母亲呵护公主的情景。
Phoenix leading its fledgling: Means a phoenix with its young, metaphorically meaning a mother's care for her children. Here, "that day the phoenix led its fledgling, you skillfully smiled and restrained" refers to the past scene of the mother caring for the princess.

掌离珠："离珠"本指古代神话中的明目者，这里代指失去女儿的痛苦。"掌离珠，我成气喑"指因失去女儿而哽咽难言。
Hold the Separated Pearl: "Separated Pearl" originally referred to a clear-sighted person in ancient myth; here it represents the pain of losing a daughter. "Holding the Separated Pearl, I become voiceless" means being choked up and unable to speak due to losing the daughter.

目连经卷：即《血盆经》，与目连救母的典故相关，这里"俺曾写下了目连经卷也"指曾为公主祈福。
Maudgalyayana sutra scrolls: I.e., the Blood Bowl Sutra, related to the story of Maudgalyayana saving his mother. Here, "I once copied down the Maudgalyayana sutra scrolls" means he had performed sutra copying for the princess's benefit.

凤箫楼：指公主居住的楼阁，这里"俺则道他在凤箫楼不挂心"指原以为公主在宫中无忧无虑。
Phoenix Flute Tower: Refers to the tower where the princess lived. Here, "I just thought she in the Phoenix Flute Tower had no cares" means he originally thought the princess was carefree in the palace.

姮娥：即嫦娥，神话中月宫中的仙子，这里"可甚的为有姮娥月易沉"以嫦娥比喻公主，感叹其逝去。
Heng'e: I.e., Chang'e, the immortal in the moon palace in mythology. Here, "why is it that because of Heng'e the moon easily sinks?" uses Chang'e as a metaphor for the princess, lamenting her death.

饯双飞：指为夫妻二人饯行，这里"还记的饯双飞，俺御酒斟"指曾为公主和驸马饯行。
Farewell for the pair flying together: Means seeing off the married couple. Here, "still remember the farewell for the pair flying together, I poured the imperial wine" refers to having held a farewell for the princess and Consort.

洒归旌："归旌"指归来的旌旗，这里代指灵柩，"洒归旌，把红泪饮"指对着归来的灵柩哭泣。
Sprinkle the returning banners: "Returning banners" refers to the banners of the returning procession, here representing the coffin. "Sprinkle the returning banners, drink red tears" means weeping before the returning coffin.

鸾驾：古代帝王或后妃的车驾，这里"将半副鸾驾迎丧"指用隆重的礼仪迎接公主的灵柩。
Phoenix carriage: The carriage of an ancient emperor or consort. Here, "use half a phoenix carriage to meet the funeral" means receiving the princess's coffin with solemn ceremony.

修仪宫：宫殿名，这里指停放公主灵柩的宫殿。
Xiuyi Palace: Name of a palace; here it means the palace where the princess's coffin is placed.

谥赠：指古代帝王或高官去世后，朝廷赐予的谥号和追赠的官爵，这里"其谥赠一应礼节"指为公主办理丧葬相关的礼仪。
Posthumous title and honors: Refers to the posthumous title and honorary offices bestowed by the court after the death of an emperor or high official. Here, "all rituals for her posthumous title and honors" means handling the funeral and burial ceremonies for the princess.

乘龙骖凤："乘龙"指成为帝王女婿（驸马），"骖凤"指乘坐由凤鸟驾引的车驾，形容尊贵。这里"道南柯乘龙骖凤"指淳于棼在南柯身为驸马的尊贵身份。
Ride the dragon, harness the phoenix: "Ride the dragon" means becoming the emperor's son-in-law (Consort); "harness the phoenix" means riding in a carriage drawn by phoenixes, describing honor. Here, "they say in Nanke you rode the dragon and harnessed the phoenix" refers to Chunyu Fen's honorable status as Consort in Nanke.

断弦：比喻妻子去世，这里"断弦难弄"指公主去世，如同琴弦断裂难以再奏。
Broken string: Metaphor for the death of a wife. Here, "a broken string is hard to play" means the princess's death is like a broken string that can no longer be played.

玉楼么凤："玉楼"指华美的楼阁，"么凤"即桐花凤，羽毛美丽，常喻指女子。这里"生打散玉楼么凤"指公主离世，如同美丽的么凤离散。
Jade tower's tiny phoenix: "Jade tower" means a magnificent tower; "tiny phoenix" is the tung flower phoenix (a small bird), with beautiful feathers, often metaphorically meaning a woman. Here, "living, scattered the jade tower's tiny phoenix" means the princess's death scattered the beautiful tiny phoenix.

龟山：传说中适合安葬的山名，这里"龟山一穴甚佳"指右相提议将公主葬于龟山。
Tortoise Mountain:It is said that a mountain name suitable for burial. Here, "a grave site on Tortoise Mountain is excellent" means the Right Minister suggests burying the princess on Tortoise Mountain.

蟠龙冈：地名，因形似蟠龙而得名，被认为是风水好的地方。这里"国东十里外蟠龙冈，气脉甚好"指淳于棼提议将公主葬于蟠龙冈。
Coiling Dragon Ridge: A place name, named for its resemblance to a coiling dragon, considered a place with good feng shui. Here, "Coiling Dragon Ridge ten li east of the state, the energy veins are very good" means Chunyu Fen suggests burying the princess on Coiling Dragon Ridge.

玄武：古代神话中的北方之神，形象为龟蛇合体，常与丧葬风水相关。这里"肯教他玄武低藏"指龟山的风水适合安葬。
Dark Warrior: The northern god in ancient mythology, depicted as a tortoise-snake hybrid, often associated with burial feng shui. Here, "willing to let the Dark Warrior lie low" means Tortoise Mountain's feng shui is suitable for burial.

蚁垤：指蚂蚁做的土堆，这里"不做了蚁垤高封"指反对将墓地封得像蚁垤一样简陋。
Anthill: Refers to a mound made by ants. Here, "not making a high mound like an anthill" means opposing making the burial mound as crude as an anthill.

蛾眉对案："蛾眉"指女子的眉毛，代指女子；"对案"指相对的山案。这里形容龟山的风水有如同女子眉毛般的山案相对。
Moth eyebrows facing the table: "Moth eyebrows" means a woman's eyebrows, representing a woman; "facing the table" means facing mountain formations resembling a table. Here it describes Tortoise Mountain's feng shui as having mountain formations opposite it like moth eyebrows.

金诰生花："金诰"指帝王的诰命文书，这里形容龟山风水能带来福禄，如诰命生花。
Golden edicts produce flowers: "Golden edicts" means imperial edicts; here it describes Tortoise Mountain's feng shui as able to bring fortune and rank, like edicts producing flowers.

罗带临风："罗带"比喻曲折的河流，这里形容龟山附近有河流如罗带般迎风摆动。
Gauze belt in the wind: "Gauze belt" metaphorically means a winding river; here it describes a river near Tortoise Mountain swaying in the wind like a gauze belt.

龙虎峰：指形似龙虎的山峰，常作为风水好的标志。这里"世人只知龙虎峰上更生峰"指世人只知龙虎峰的好风水。
Dragon and Tiger Peaks: Peaks resembling a dragon and tiger, often considered marks of good feng shui. Here, "the world only knows that on Dragon and Tiger Peaks grow further peaks" means people only know the good feng shui of Dragon and Tiger Peaks.

龟蛇洞：指形似龟蛇的洞穴，与玄武相关，这里"怎知道龟蛇洞里方成洞"强调龟山洞穴的风水优势。
Tortoise and Snake Cave: A cave resembling a tortoise and snake, related to the Dark Warrior. Here, "how would they know that within the Tortoise and Snake Cave lies the true cave?" emphasizes the feng shui advantages of Tortoise Mountain's cave.

三千粉黛，八百烟花："粉黛"指女子，"烟花"指繁华景象，这里形容蟠龙冈周边如繁华之地，有众多美好景致。
Three thousand painted brows, eight hundred fireworks and willows: "Painted brows" means women; "fireworks and willows" means bustling scenes; here it describes the area around Coiling Dragon Ridge as being like a prosperous place with many beautiful sights.

十二屛峰：指十二座如屏风般的山峰，形容山势优美。这里"更那十二屛峰"指蟠龙冈周边有十二座屏风似的山峰。
Twelve screen peaks: Twelve screen-like peaks, describing beautiful mountain scenery. Here, "furthermore those twelve screen peaks" means there are twelve screen-like peaks around Coiling Dragon Ridge.

鸣环动佩："环""佩"都是古代女子的饰品，行走时发出声响，代指女子。这里"鸣环动佩应雌雄"指蟠龙冈的风水适合阴阳调和，如女子饰品相应。
Rings chime, pendants move: "Rings" and "pendants" were ancient women's ornaments that made sound when moving, representing women. Here, "rings chiming, pendants moving, responding male and female" means Coiling Dragon Ridge's feng shui is suitable for balancing yin and yang, like women's ornaments responding.

辞楼下殿：指离开楼阁宫殿，这里喻指公主离世。"辞楼下殿交鸾凤"指公主离世后灵魂如鸾凤般相聚。
Leave tower, descend hall: Means leaving the towers and halls; here it metaphorically means the princess's death. "Leave tower, descend hall, phoenixes meet" means the princess's soul meets (her husband's?) like phoenixes after death.

纨袴插金貂："纨袴"指富贵子弟，"金貂"指高官的冠饰，这里形容国公王亲的富贵身份。"纨袴插金貂，日近天颜笑"指国公王亲身份尊贵，能接近帝王。
Silken-robed youths adorned with golden sable insignia: "Silken-robed youths" refers to scions of wealthy families; "golden sable insignia" refers to high officials' head ornaments; here it describes the noble and wealthy status of dukes and imperial relatives. The line "Silken-robed youths adorned with golden sable, daily near the celestial countenance, smiling" means dukes and imperial relatives, being honorable, can approach the emperor.

日边红杏倚云高：化用唐代高蟾《下第后上永崇高侍郎》"天上碧桃和露种，日边红杏倚云栽"，原指科举得中者受帝王赏识，这里形容驸马受帝王恩宠，地位崇高。
Red apricots by the sun lean on clouds, high: Adapts Gao Chan's (Tang) line "Heavenly peaches planted with dew, / Red apricots by the sun lean on clouds, grown." Originally referred to successful exam candidates receiving imperial favor; here it describes the Consort's high status and imperial favor.

乘龙拜相："乘龙"指做驸马，"拜相"指担任宰相，这里"喜乘龙拜相，驸马还朝"指淳于棼以驸马身份升任宰相回朝。
Ride the dragon and become Chancellor: "Ride the dragon" means becoming the emperor's son-in-law (Consort); "become Chancellor" means being appointed Chancellor. The line "Joyfully ride the dragon and become Chancellor, the Consort returns to court" means Chunyu Fen was promoted to Chancellor and returned to court in his capacity as Consort.

凤箫：指乐器，代指欢乐的时光，这里"南柯去时有凤箫"指前往南柯时的欢乐情景。
Phoenix flute: Refers to the instrument, representing happy times. The line "When going to Nanke, there was the phoenix flute" refers to the joyful circumstances when departing for Nanke.

鹊桥：传说中牛郎织女相会的桥，这里"北渚归来无鹊桥"指归来时公主已逝，如同鹊桥断裂，再无相聚可能。
Magpie Bridge: The bridge where the Cowherd and Weaver Girl meet in legend. The line "Returning from the northern isle, no Magpie Bridge" means upon return, the princess was dead, as if the bridge was broken, with no chance of reunion.

何郞粉泪："何郞"指何晏，三国魏人，面色白皙，这里代指男子流泪。"怕何郞粉泪淹消"指担心淳于棼因悲伤而日渐憔悴。
He Lang's powdered tears: "He Lang" refers to He Yan of Cao Wei (Three Kingdoms), known for his fair complexion; here it represents a man weeping. The line "Fear He Lang's powdered tears will drown and fade him" means worrying that Chunyu Fen would waste away from grief.

戚畹：指外戚，即帝王的外戚亲属，这里"俺朝班戚畹"指国公王亲身为外戚。
Imperial relatives by marriage: Refers to the emperor's relatives by marriage. The line "We, the court ranks of imperial relatives" means the dukes and imperial relatives are part of the imperial in-laws.

香风簇锦云汉高：形容驸马受宠，如香风簇拥，地位高如锦云在天。
Fragrant breezes簇拥 brocade clouds high in the Milky Way: Describes the Consort's favor, as if clustering round by fragrant winds, his status as high as brocade clouds in heaven.

夜月穿花宫漏遥：形容宫廷生活的美好与悠远，这里指驸马曾有的宫廷美好生活。
Night moon pierces flowers, palace water clock distant: Describes the beauty and remoteness of palace life; here it refers to the splendid palace life the Consort once had.

股肱相："股肱"比喻辅佐帝王的重臣，这里"权重股肱相"指淳于棼身为宰相，权力重要如帝王的股肱。
Chancellor, arms and thighs: "Arms and thighs" metaphorically means the key ministers assisting the emperor. The line "Powerful Chancellor, arms and thighs" means Chunyu Fen, as Chancellor, held power as vital as the emperor's limbs.

秦楼梦断："秦楼"原指传说中秦穆公为女儿弄玉所建之楼，后常代指女子居所或男女情爱之地。这里"秦楼梦断"指公主离世，过往的情爱与梦境随之破灭。
Qin Tower's dream severed: "Qin Tower" originally referred to the tower built by Duke Mu of Qin for his daughter Nongyu; later it often represented a woman's quarters or a place of romance. Here, "Qin Tower's dream severed" means the princess's death shattered past love and dreams.

凤笙罗帐："凤笙"指饰有凤纹的笙，代指欢乐的乐曲；"罗帐"指丝罗帐幕，代指闺房。这里"凤笙罗帐"形容昔日公主闺中的欢乐场景，如今已不复存在。
Phoenix sheng and gauze bed curtains: "Phoenix sheng" means a sheng instrument decorated with phoenixes, representing joyful music; "gauze bed curtains" means silk curtains, representing the women's chambers. Here, "phoenix sheng and gauze bed curtains" describes the past joyful scenes in the princess's chambers, now gone.

西明讲："西明"指西明寺，唐代著名寺院，常为文人聚会讲学之地。这里"出听西明讲"指昔日姐妹曾一同听讲佛法。
Western Brightness lectures: "Western Brightness" refers to the Ximing Temple, a famous Tang Dynasty monastery often used for literary gatherings and lectures. The line "Went out to hear lectures at Western Brightness" means the sisters once went together to listen to Buddhist teachings.

瑶台贵婿："瑶台"指仙境或华美的台阁，这里代指公主；"贵婿"指驸马。"瑶台贵婿真无两"赞淳于棼作为公主驸马的尊贵难得。
Jade Terrace's noble son-in-law: "Jade Terrace" means an immortal realm or magnificent tower, here representing the princess; "noble son-in-law" means the Consort. The line "Jade Terrace's noble son-in-law truly has no equal" praises Chunyu Fen's unique and honourable status as the princess's Consort.

翠袖风流："翠袖"代指女子，这里指公主。"恰好翠袖风流少一双"感叹公主离世后，夫妻成双的风流景象不再。
Emerden sleeves, romantic grace: "Emerald sleeves" represents women, here the princess. The line "Precisely, emerald sleeves, romantic grace, missing one pair" laments that after the princess's death, the romantic image of the couple is gone.

同昌公主：唐代懿宗之女，生前备受宠爱，死后葬礼极其奢华。这里"似同昌，公主哀荣不可当"以南朝同昌公主的奢华葬礼类比顺义公主的哀荣。
Princess Tongchang: Daughter of Emperor Yizong of Tang, greatly favored in life, with an extremely lavish funeral after death. The line "Resembling Tongchang, the princess's posthumous honors are unbearable" compares Princess Shunyi's lavish funeral to that of Princess Tongchang.

玉磬归天响："玉磬"指玉制的乐器，声音清越；"归天"指死亡。这里"敲残玉磬归天响"指葬礼上的玉磬声象征公主魂归上天。
Jade chime returns to heaven's sound: "Jade chime" is a jade instrument with a clear sound; "return to heaven" means death. The line "Striking the fading jade chime, returns to heaven's sound" means the sound of the jade chime at the funeral symbolizes the princess's soul ascending to heaven.

鸾旌拂地长："鸾旌"指饰有鸾鸟图案的旌旗，用于仪仗；"拂地长"形容旌旗长垂拖地。这里"摆下鸾旌拂地长"描绘公主葬礼仪仗的盛大。
Phoenix banners sweep the ground long: "Phoenix banners" are banners with phoenix designs used in processions; "sweep the ground long" describes the banners hanging long and touching the ground. The line "Displayed phoenix banners sweep the ground long" depicts the grandeur of the princess's funeral procession.

头厅相：指首席宰相，地位尊崇。这里"如今又做了头厅相"指淳于棼升任首席宰相。
Head of the Council Chancellor: Refers to the chief Chancellor, a highly position. The line "Now he has also become Head of the Council Chancellor" means Chunyu Fen was promoted to chief Chancellor.

解闷浇惆怅："解闷""浇惆怅"指通过饮酒等方式排解忧愁。这里"须与他解闷浇惆怅"指要为淳于棼排解丧妻的忧愁。
Dispel gloom, douse melancholy: Means to relieve sorrow through drinking wine, etc. The line "Must dispel his gloom and douse his melancholy" means needing to help Chunyu Fen alleviate his grief for his deceased wife.

道情人：指潜心修道、断绝俗情的人。这里"我是道情人哩"指上真子自称潜心修道，不涉俗情。
Person devoted to the Dao: Means one who diligently practices Daoism and renounces worldly attachments. The line "I am a person devoted to the Dao" means Shang Zhenzi claims to be dedicated to Daoist practice, uninvolved in worldly emotions.

黏连情肠："黏连"指牵连、纠缠；"情肠"指情感。这里"怕黏连到惹动情肠"指担心因接触而引发情感纠葛。
Entangle the heartstrings: "Entangle" means to involve, entangle; "heartstrings" means emotions. The line "Fear entanglement might stir the heartstrings" means worrying that contact might provoke emotional complications.

三杯醉后能疏放：指饮酒微醉后能放开拘束。这里"倘三杯醉后能疏放"指希望淳于棼饮酒后能放松心情。
Three cups drunk, then able to relax: Means after getting slightly drunk, one can shed inhibitions. The line "If after three cups drunk he can relax" expresses the hope that Chunyu Fen can relax after drinking.

紫鸾烟驾："紫鸾"指传说中的神鸟，"烟驾"指仙人的车驾，代指帝王或尊贵者的出行仪仗。这里"则为紫鸾烟驾不同朝"指因帝王仪仗不同往昔，暗含对公主离世的怅惘。
Purple phoenix mist carriage: "Purple phoenix" is a mythical bird; "mist carriage" is an immortal's carriage, representing the imperial or noble procession. The line "It's because the purple phoenix mist carriage differs from the court" implies melancholy over the princess's death due to the changed imperial procession.

金钿秋尽雁书遥："金钿"指女子的首饰，代指公主；"雁书"指书信。这里"可怜他金钿秋尽雁书遥"感叹公主已逝，再无书信传来。
Gold hairpin, autumn ends, goose letters distant: "Gold hairpin" means women's hair ornament, representing the princess; "goose letters" means letters (carried by geese). The line "Pitiable, her gold hairpin, autumn ends, goose letters distant" laments the princess's death, with no more letters arriving.

肠断东风为玉箫："玉箫"代指乐器或女子，这里"抵多少肠断东风为玉箫"指因思念公主而如东风中闻箫般断肠。
Heart breaks in the east wind for the jade flute: "Jade flute" represents the instrument or the woman. The line "How many heartbreaks in the east wind for the jade flute" means yearning for the princess causes heartbreak like hearing a flute in the east wind.

莲步轻跷："莲步"指女子轻盈的脚步，这里形容女官行走轻盈。
Lotus steps lightly raised: "Lotus steps" means a woman's graceful footsteps; here it describes the lady official walking lightly.

鸾霄：指高空，代指皇宫或仙界，这里"多应娘娘懿旨下鸾霄"指猜测女官传旨来自皇宫。
Phoenix heavens: Means the high sky, representing the imperial palace or immortal realm. The line "Most likely the noble consort's decree descends from the phoenix heavens" means speculating the lady official's edict comes from the palace.

青禽传报："青禽"即青鸟，神话中传递消息的神鸟，这里"青禽传报去"指派人传递消息。
Blue bird conveys news: "Blue bird" is the mythical bird that carries messages. The line "The blue bird conveys news away" means sending someone to deliver a message.

恹恹睡损："恹恹"形容精神萎靡，"睡损"指因睡眠不佳而憔悴。这里"恹恹睡损，无人偎傍"形容郡主寡居的孤寂。
Listless, sleep-damaged: "Listless" means spiritless; "sleep-damaged" means haggard from poor sleep. The line "Listless, sleep-damaged, no one to lean against" describes the infanta 's loneliness in widowhood.

玉楼欢唱："玉楼"指华美的楼阁，这里"叨陪侍玉楼欢唱"指在楼阁中陪伴欢饮歌唱。
Jade tower merry singing: "Jade tower" means a magnificent tower. The line "Presumptuously accompany and serve at jade tower merry singing" means accompanying and serving during merry drinking and singing in the tower.

三来解孤栖之闷："孤栖"指独居，这里指为淳于棼排解丧妻后的独居烦闷。
Thirdly, to relieve the gloom of solitary dwelling: "Solitary dwelling" means living alone; here it means relieving Chunyu Fen's loneliness after losing his wife.

迤逗多娇粉面郞："迤逗"指挑逗，"粉面郞"指面容俊美的男子。这里指淳于棼回忆曾被女子挑逗的情景。
Tease the charming, powdered-face lad: "Tease" means to flirt; "powdered-face lad" means a handsome man. Here it refers to Chunyu Fen recalling being teased by women.

汉宫春那人："汉宫春"指汉代宫廷的春色，代指美好女子，这里指思念中的女子。
Han palace spring, that person: "Han palace spring" represents the spring scenery of the Han palace, metaphorically a beautiful woman; here it means the woman he longs for.

锦瑟傍："锦瑟"指精美的瑟，代指欢乐的场景，这里"来暂借佳人锦瑟傍"指借与女子相聚排遣忧愁。
By the brocade zither: "Brocade zither" means an exquisite zither, representing joyful scenes. The line "Come temporarily borrow the beauty by the brocade zither" means seeking temporary solace by being with a woman.

凤管声残："凤管"指箫笛等乐器，这里"怎得玉人无恙？恰咱风吹断凤管声残"感叹公主已逝，如乐器声断。
Phoenix pipe's sound fades: "Phoenix pipe" means flute-like instruments. The line "How can the jade person be unharmed? Just as the wind breaks the phoenix pipe's fading sound" laments the princess's death, like the breaking of music.

锦绣乡：指繁华安乐的境地，这里"这是翠拥红遮锦绣乡"形容与女子相聚的欢乐场景。
Brocade embroidery land: Means a place of prosperity and happiness. The line "This is emerald embracing, red veiling, brocade embroidery land" describes the joyful scene of being with women.

八眉相向："八眉"指多样的眉态，代指女子的神态，这里"芳心一点，做了八眉相向"形容女子情意显露于神态。
Eight brows facing each other: "Eight brows" means various eyebrow expressions, representing a woman's demeanor. The line "A bit of fragrant heart, makes eight brows face each other" describes the woman's affection showing in her expression.

纱厨枕帐："纱厨"指纱制的帐子，这里"早已安排纱厨枕帐了"指准备好休息的帐榻。
Gauze cabinet, pillow and curtains: "Gauze cabinet" means a gauze canopy. The line "Have long prepared the gauze cabinet, pillow and curtains" means the bed for rest is ready.

鱼贯而入：指如鱼群游动般依次进入，这里"我三人鱼贯而入"指三位女子依次进入内室。
Enter in single file: Means entering one after another like a school of fish. The line "We three enter in single file" means the three women enter the inner chamber sequentially.

望夫石：传说中女子化为石头等待丈夫归来，这里"望夫石都衬迭床儿上"调侃女子如望夫石般依偎在床。
Gazing-for-husband stone:It is said that a woman turned to stone waiting for her husband's return. The line "Gazing-for-husband stones are all piled on the bed" jokes that the women are nestled on the bed like the stone.

团圞相："团圞"指团圆，这里"今宵试做团圞相"指今夜尝试团圆欢乐的情景。
Reunion appearance: "Reunion" means family to be together. The line "Tonight try to make a reunion appearance" means attempting a scene of joyful reunion tonight.

梅红帐：指红色的帐子，这里"满床娇不下得梅红帐"形容帐中娇美的情景。
Plum-red bed curtains: Refers to red bed curtains. The line "A bed full of beauties cannot leave the plum-red curtains" describes the lovely scene within the curtains.

姊妹花开：比喻女子们如花开般美好，这里"看姊妹花开向月光"形容女子们在月光下的美好姿态。
Sister flowers bloom: Metaphorically means women are as beautiful as blooming flowers. The line "Watch the sister flowers bloom towards the moonlight" describes the women's beautiful postures in the moonlight.

铜龙漏水：古代计时器，以铜壶盛水，通过滴水计算时间，"铜龙"为壶上装饰。这里"咽不断铜龙漏水"指时光在滴漏声中不断流逝。
Bronze dragon leaks water: An ancient timekeeper with a bronze water jar; the "bronze dragon" is a decoration. The line "Gurgling incessantly, the bronze dragon leaks water" means time passes continuously with the dripping sound.

树大根摇：比喻势力强大后会威胁根基。这里"下官每有树大根摇之虑"指右相担心淳于棼权势过盛威胁国家。
A large tree's roots shake: Metaphorically means great power can threaten the foundation. The line "This official often has fears of a large tree's roots shaking" means the Right Minister worries Chunyu Fen's excessive power threatens the state.

客星犯于牛、女、虚、危之次："客星"指异常出现的星，"牛、女、虚、危"为星宿名，古人认为星象异常预示灾祸。这里指太史令奏报异常星象，暗示国家将有变故。
Guest star intrudes upon the stations of Ox, Maiden, Emptiness, Rooftop: "Guest star" means an anomalously appearing star; "Ox, Maiden, Emptiness, Rooftop" are asterism names; ancients believed celestial anomalies foretold disaster. Here, the Grand Astrologer reports abnormal phenomena,hinting state upheaval.

衅起他族，事在萧墙："衅"指争端，"萧墙"指内部。全句意为争端起于外族，祸乱却在内部发生。这里指上书人警示国家内有隐患。
Strike originates from other clans, trouble lies within the screen wall: "Strike" means conflict; "screen wall" means inside the household. The whole sentence means conflict starts externally but the trouble is internal. Here, the petitioner warns of internal danger.

非我族类：指不是本族群的人。这里"淳于驸马，非我族类"指国王怀疑淳于棼非本国族人，不可信任。
Not of our kind: Means not belonging to our ethnic group. The line "Consort Chunyu is not of our kind" means the King suspects Chunyu Fen is not a native and is untrustworthy.

乘槎客子："乘槎"典出神话中有人乘槎至天河，代指远行归来之人。这里"正值乘槎客子归"指淳于棼从南柯回朝。
Raft-riding traveler:From mythology of someone riding a raft to the Milky Way, represents a traveler returning from afar. The line "Just when the raft-riding traveler returns" means Chunyu Fen's return from Nanke.

虚、危主都邑宗庙之事：古代星象学认为虚、危二星宿主管都城和宗庙的吉凶。这里右相以此附会星象，暗示国家根基有险。
Emptiness and Rooftop govern affairs of the capital and ancestral temples: Ancient astrology held that these asterisms governed the fortune of the capital and temples. Here, the Right Minister uses this to correlate with the stars,hinting the state's foundation is at risk.

牛、女值公主驸马之星：认为牛、女二星宿对应公主和驸马的运势。这里指星象异常与公主驸马相关。
Ox and Maiden correspond to the stars of princess and consort: Believes these asterisms influence the fortune of the princess and consort. Here, the celestial anomaly is linked to them.

宣淫任所为："宣淫"指公开放纵淫欲。这里"不道他宣淫任所为"指责淳于棼行为放纵无度。
Indulge in open lewdness without restraint: "Open lewdness" means publicly indulging lust. The line "Unexpectedly, he indulges in open lewdness without restraint" accuses Chunyu Fen of extreme licentiousness.

僭侈堪疑："僭侈"指超越本分的奢华。这里"他平常僭侈堪疑"指淳于棼日常奢华逾矩，令人怀疑。
Usurpous extravagance is suspect: "Usurpous extravagance" means luxury beyond one's station. The line "His usual usurpous extravagance is suspect" means Chunyu Fen's daily luxury is excessive and suspicious.

当断不断，反受其乱：指该决断时不决断，反而会遭受祸乱。这里右相以此劝国王及时处置淳于棼。
Hesitate when a decision is needed, and you will suffer the chaos: Means failing to act decisively leads to disaster. Here, the Right Minister urges the King to deal with Chunyu Fen promptly.

夺了淳于棼侍卫，禁随朝只许他居私第：指国王下令剥夺淳于棼的侍卫，禁止其入朝，只准居住私宅。这是对淳于棼的惩戒。
Strip Chunyu Fen of his guards, forbid court attendance, only allow him to reside in his private residence: Means the King ordered Chunyu Fen's guards removed, banned him from court, and confined him to his home. This is punishment.

太行之路能摧车，若比君心是坦途。黄河之水能覆舟，若比君心是安流：化用古诗中以自然险阻喻人心难测的意象。原意为太行山能摧折车辆，黄河水能颠覆船只，但比起君王的心意，它们都算平坦安稳。这里淳于棼以此感叹君王心意多变难测。
The Taihang path can wreck carts, / But compared to the ruler's heart, it is a smooth road. / The Yellow River's water can capsize boats, / But compared to the ruler's heart, it is a calm flow.: Adapts poetic imagery using natural dangers to metaphorically describe the unpredictability of the ruler's heart. The original means these hazards are tame compared to the ruler's whims. Here, Chunyu Fen laments the King's changeable and inscrutable heart.

连柯并蒂作门楣："连柯并蒂"指草木枝柯相连、花朵并蒂，比喻夫妻和睦、家族兴旺。这里"大槐淳于尚主时，连柯并蒂作门楣"指淳于棼做驸马时家族兴盛的景象。
Intertwined branches and twin blossoms form the lintel: "Intertwined branches and twin blossoms" means branches growing together and flowers blooming in pairs, metaphorically meaning marital harmony and family prosperity. The line "When the locust tree's Chunyu married the princess, intertwined branches and twin blossoms formed the lintel" refers to the family's flourishing when Chunyu Fen became Consort.

珊瑚叶上鸳鸯鸟，凤凰窠里鹓雏儿："鸳鸯鸟"象征夫妻恩爱，"鹓雏"为凤凰一类的鸟，象征高贵子孙。这里形容淳于棼昔日家庭美满、子孙尊贵。
Mandarin ducks on coral leaves, phoenix chicks in the phoenix nest: "Mandarin ducks" symbolize conjugal love; "phoenix chicks" are birds like phoenixes, symbolizing noble offspring. Here it describes Chunyu Fen's past happy family and esteemed descendants.

叶碎柯残坐消歇："叶碎柯残"比喻家族衰败。这里指公主去世后，淳于棼家族运势衰落。
Leaves shattered, branches broken, sitting in decline: "Leaves shattered, branches broken" metaphorically means family decline. Here it means the family's fortune declined after the princess's death.

宝镜无光履声绝："宝镜"象征夫妻情谊，"履声"指官员上朝的脚步声。这里指夫妻情断、失去朝见资格的凄凉。
Precious mirror lacks light, footstep sounds cease: "Precious mirror" symbolizes marital bonds; "footstep sounds" mean the sound of officials going to court. Here it means the end of marital love and the loss of court access, desolate.

一朝负谴辞丹阙："负谴"指获罪，"丹阙"指皇宫。这里指突然获罪被禁止入朝。
One morning, bearing blame, leave the vermilion towers: "Bearing blame" means being found guilty; "vermilion towers" mean the imperial palace. Here it means suddenly being condemned and barred from court.

客星一夜，犯虚、危汉槎："客星""虚、危"为星宿名，"汉槎"指天河中的木筏，代指远行之人。这里指星象异常，客星侵犯虚、危二宿，被附会为淳于棼带来灾祸。
A guest star overnight intrudes upon Emptiness, Rooftop, and the Han raft: "Guest star", "Emptiness", "Rooftop" are asterisms; "Han raft" means the raft to the Milky Way, represents a traveler. Here, the celestial anomaly, the guest star intruding, is attributed to Chunyu Fen bringing disaster.

玄象谪见，国有大恐，都邑迁徙，宗庙崩坏："玄象谪见"指星象显示灾异，全句意为星象异常预示国家将有大难，都城迁徙，宗庙崩塌。这里指国人上书的警示内容。
The mysterious heavens show portents, the state has great fear, the capital moves, the ancestral temples collapse: "Mysterious heavens show portents" means celestial phenomena indicate disaster; the whole sentence means the anomaly foretells great calamity: capital relocation, temple ruin. Here, it's the warning in the citizens' petition.

衅生他族，变起萧墙："衅"指争端，"萧墙"指内部。全句指争端起于外族，祸乱却在内部发生。这里指上书人暗示淳于棼为内部隐患。
Strike arises from other clans, change starts within the screen wall: "Strike" means conflict; "screen wall" means inside. The whole sentence means conflict starts externally but upheaval begins internally. Here, the petitioner hints Chunyu Fen is the internal danger.

右相段功就中谗谮："谗谮"指恶意中伤。这里指淳于棼指责右相段功从中挑拨陷害。
Right Minister Duan Gong therein slandered and calumniated: "Slandered and calumniated" means maliciously defamed. Here, Chunyu Fen accuses the Right Minister of instigating and framing him.

虚、危者宗庙也；客星犯牛、女者、宫闱事也：古代星象学认为虚、危星宿主宗庙吉凶，牛、女星宿主宫闱之事。这里指右相附会星象，将灾祸与淳于棼关联。
Emptiness and Rooftower represent the ancestral temples; a guest star intruding upon Ox and Maiden concerns palace matters: Ancient astrology held these asterisms governed temple fortune and palace affairs respectively. Here, the Right Minister correlates the stars to blame Chunyu Fen.

琼芝新寡，三杯后有甚么风流话靶："琼芝"指琼英郡主和灵芝夫人，"话靶"指谈笑的由头。这里指右相诬陷淳于棼与寡居的郡主夫人有风流之事。
Qiongzhi newly widowed, after three cups, what romantic gossip could there be?: "Qiongzhi" refers to Princess Qiongying and Lady Lingzhi; "gossip" means topic for mockery. Here, the Right Minister falsely accuses Chunyu Fen of affairs with the widowed princesses.

驸马弄权结党，不可容矣：指国王指责淳于棼专权结党，不能容忍。
The Consort manipulates power and forms cliques, this is intolerable: Means the King accuses Chunyu Fen of usurping power and factionalism, which is unacceptable.

说到萧墙话，中宫怎劝他："中宫"指国母，这里指涉及内部祸乱的话，国母也难以劝解国王。
Speaking of screen wall talk, how can the Central Palace persuade him?: "Central Palace" means the Empress. Here, it means even the Empress finds it hard to advise the King on matters of internal strife.

夫子常独立，鲤趋而过庭：出自《论语》，孔子独立时，儿子鲤快步过庭受教。这里借典故表示对君命的恭敬，闻命即行。
The Master often stood alone, Li hurried past the courtyard: From the Analects; when Confucius stood alone, his son Li hurried past the courtyard to receive instruction. Here, the story is used to show respect for the royal command, obeying immediately upon hearing it.

一闻君命召，不俟驾而行：出自《论语》，指听到君王召见，不等车马备好就起身。这里表示淳于棼接旨后即刻前往。
Hearing the sovereign's summons, not waiting for the carriage, but going on foot: From the Analects; means setting out immediately upon the ruler's summons without waiting for the carriage. Here, it means Chunyu Fen went immediately after receiving the decree.

王气余霄汉："王气"指帝王之气，"霄汉"指高空。这里"王气余霄汉"指国家的帝王之气仍存于高空。
Royal aura remains in the heavens: "Royal aura" means the imperial majesty; "heavens" means the high sky. Here, it means the state's imperial majesty still exists in the heavens.

玄象凌乱："玄象"指星象，这里"伤心玄象，为谁凌乱"指国王为异常的星象而伤心，不知灾祸因谁而起。
The mysterious heavens are in disarray: "Mysterious heavens" means the celestial phenomena. The line "Heartbroken by the mysterious heavens' disarray, for whom?" means the King is saddened by the abnormal stars, not knowing who caused the disaster.

意外包弹，就中离间："包弹"指指责，"离间"指挑拨。这里指因意外的指责和挑拨而产生矛盾。
Unexpected criticism, therein sowing discord: "Criticism" means blame; "sowing discord" means instigation. Here, it means conflicts arose from unexpected accusations and provocation.

长秋：汉代皇后的宫名，后代指皇后。这里"默坐长秋心暗焦"指国母在宫中暗自焦虑。
Eternal Autumn: Name of the Han Empress's palace, later referring to the Empress. The line "Silently sitting in Eternal Autumn, heart secretly anxious" means the Empress is secretly worried in the palace.

粉郞：指面容俊美的男子，这里代指淳于棼。"这些时宫闺不见粉郞朝"指近来宫中不见淳于棼朝见。
Powdered lord: Means a handsome man; here it refers to Chunyu Fen. The line "Recently, the palace chambers have not seen the powdered lord at court" means Chunyu Fen hasn't been attending court lately.

空房入地牢：指将淳于棼禁于私宅，如同入狱。这里"俺处置他空房入地牢"指国王对淳于棼的惩戒。
Empty room becomes an underground prison: Means confining Chunyu Fen to his residence is like imprisonment. The line "I disposed of him: empty room into an underground prison" means the King's punishment of Chunyu Fen.

于家为国苦无聊：指淳于棼为家为国操劳却无所依靠。这里国母为淳于棼辩解，称其并非放纵之人。
For family and state, suffering with no support: Means Chunyu Fen worked hard for family and country but had no reliance. Here, the Empress defends him, saying he was not profligate.

星象吿变，社稷崩移；祸起萧墙，衅生他族：重复前文上书内容，指星象示警国家将有灾祸，祸乱起于内部和外族。这里国王再次以此为由指责淳于棼。
The stars announce change, the altars of soil and grain collapse and shift; calamity arises within the screen wall, strike originates from other clans: Repeats the petition content: celestial signs warn of national disaster originating internally and externally. Here, the King again blames Chunyu Fen.

贵坦：指女婿，"贵坦"为对女婿的尊称。这里"堪叹，吾家贵坦"指国王感叹淳于棼这位女婿。
Noble son-in-law: "Noble son-in-law" is a respectful term for son-in-law. The line "Lamentable, our family's noble son-in-law" means the King sighs over Chunyu Fen.

关南饯别，对影鸣銮："关南"指南方关口，"鸣銮"指帝王车驾的声响。这里回忆昔日为淳于棼饯行的情景。
South of the Pass farewell, facing shadows, jingling bridles: "South of the Pass" means south of the strategic pass; "jingling bridles" means the sound of the imperial carriage. Here, it recalls the past farewell for Chunyu Fen.

三爵：古代饮酒礼，三杯为一爵，"三爵"指适量饮酒。这里"臣饮过三爵"指淳于棼已按礼饮酒。
Three cupfuls: Ancient drinking ritual, three cups made one measure; "three cupfuls" means drinking moderately. The line "Your subject has drunk three cupfuls" means Chunyu Fen drank according to ritual.

客星何处？天恩见宽："客星"指前文异常星象，这里淳于棼问客星何在，祈求君王恩宽。
Where is the guest star? May heavenly grace show leniency: "Guest star" refers to the earlier anomaly. Here, Chunyu Fen asks where it is, begging for the King's mercy.

卿本人间，家非在此：指国王点明淳于棼本是人间之人，非属大槐安国。这里揭示淳于棼的来历。
You are originally from the human world, your home is not here: Means the King clarifies that Chunyu Fen is from the human world, not from Great Huai'an. This reveals his origin.

向迷中发悟：指从迷惑中醒悟。这里"向迷中发悟，有泪阑珊"指淳于棼醒悟自己本在人间，伤感落泪。
From within confusion, gain enlightenment: Means becoming enlightened from delusion. The line "From within confusion, gain enlightenment, with tears streaming" means Chunyu Fen realizes he is from the human world and sheds sad tears.

因风好去到人间：指借风势回到人间。这里国王劝淳于棼返回人间。
Riding the wind, nicely go to the human world: Means returning to the human world with the wind. Here, the King advises Chunyu Fen to return.

三杯酒尽笙歌散：指宴席结束，笙歌停歇。这里喻指淳于棼在大槐安国的经历如宴席般终结。
Three cups of wine finished, pipes and songs disperse: Means the banquet ends, music stops. Here it metaphorically means Chunyu Fen's experience in Huai'an ends like a banquet.

攀留大难：指难以挽留。这里"归心顿起，攀留大难"指淳于棼归心已决，难以挽留。
Clinging and detaining is very difficult: Means hard to persuade to stay. The line "Thoughts of return suddenly arise, clinging and detaining is very difficult" means Chunyu Fen is determined to return and cannot be detained.

宗庙崩移你长在眼：指担心国家宗庙崩坏，希望淳于棼能见证。这里国王和国母感叹国家可能面临的变故。
The ancestral temples collapse and shift, may you long see it: Means worrying about the temples' ruin and hoping Chunyu Fen witnesses it. Here, the King and Empress lament the possible state disaster.

绿暗红稀出凤城："绿暗红稀"指暮春时节绿叶繁茂、红花凋零，"凤城"指京城。这里"趁着这绿暗红稀出凤城"指淳于棼在暮春时节离开大槐安国都城。
Green dense, red sparse, leave the Phoenix City: "Green dense, red sparse" describes late spring with lush leaves and fading flowers; "Phoenix City" means the capital. The line "Taking advantage of this green dense, red sparse, leave the Phoenix City" means Chunyu Fen leaves the Huai'an capital in late spring.

秃牛单车：指简陋的牛车，与昔日驸马的奢华仪仗形成对比。这里"前面一辆秃牛单车，岂是我乘坐的？"表现淳于棼对落魄处境的震惊。
Bald ox, single cart: Means a shabby ox cart, contrasting with his former lavish procession. The line "Ahead, one bald ox, single cart, how could that be for me to ride?" shows his shock at his reduced circumstances.

金字城楼：指大槐安国都城的城楼，象征昔日的繁华与权力。这里"便是这座金字城楼了"是淳于棼对过往权势的回望。
Golden-character city tower: The tower of the Huai'an capital, symbolizing past splendor and power. The line "So this is that golden-character city tower" is Chunyu Fen looking back on his past power.

广陵郡：地名，淳于棼的故乡，这里指他即将返回的人间家乡。"广陵郡何时可到？"体现其归乡心切。
Guangling Prefecture: A place name, Chunyu Fen's hometown; here it means the human world home he returns to. "When can Guangling Prefecture be reached?" shows his eagerness.

槐根窟里：指老槐树的根部洞穴，代指大槐安国所在之处。这里"槐根窟里，有个大槐安国主女娉婷"点明大槐安国的位置。
In the locust root hole: Means the hole at the base of the old locust tree, representing where Huai'an is located. The line "In the locust root hole, there is a graceful princess of Great Huai'an" identifies Huai'an's location.

瑶芳：大槐安国公主的名字，淳于棼的妻子。这里"那公主小名，我还记得，唤做瑶芳"是淳于棼对梦中妻子的回忆。
Yaofang: The name of the Huai'an princess, Chunyu Fen's wife. The line "That princess's nickname, I still remember, was called Yaofang" is Chunyu Fen recalling his dream wife.

灵龟山：大槐安国西边的山，淳于棼曾在此陪国王狩猎。这里"曾侍猎于国西灵龟山"对应梦中的狩猎经历。
Numinous Tortoise Mountain: A mountain west of Huai'an where Chunyu Fen accompanied the King hunting. The line "Once attended a hunt at Numinous Tortoise Mountain west of the state" corresponds to the dream hunt.

南柯郡：大槐安国南部的郡，淳于棼在此担任太守二十年。这里"那国之南，有个南柯郡"点明其任职之地。
Nanke Prefecture: A prefecture south of Huai'an where Chunyu Fen was governor for twenty years. The line "South of that state, there is a Nanke Prefecture" identifies his place of service.

蟠龙冈：大槐安国东部的山冈，淳于棼为公主选的葬地。这里"归葬于国东蟠龙冈上"对应梦中公主的葬礼。
Coiling Dragon Ridge: A ridge east of Huai'an where Chunyu Fen chose the princess's burial site. The line "Returned for burial on Coiling Dragon Ridge east of the state" corresponds to the dream funeral.

鸾镜：指铜镜，代指夫妻情谊。这里"葬龙冈我凄惶煞了鸾镜"表达对公主去世的悲痛。
Phoenix mirror: Means a bronze mirror, symbolizing marital love. The line "Burying her on Dragon Ridge, I despaired, destroying the phoenix mirror" expresses grief for the princess's death.

紫衣一品：指穿紫色官服的一品官员，代指大槐安国的使者。这里"适才送我的使者二人，他都是紫衣一品"强调使者的尊贵。
First-rank purple robes: Means officials wearing purple robes of the first rank, representing Huai'an's envoys. The line "The two envoys who just saw me off, they were both first-rank purple robes" emphasizes their honor.

蚁穿成路径：指蚂蚁在树皮中穿行形成的路径，对应梦中大槐安国的道路。这里"怎只见树皮中有蚁穿成路径"揭示梦境的真相。
Ants bore forming pathways: Means paths formed by ants boring through bark, corresponding to the roads in dream Huai'an. The line "Why only see ants boring forming pathways in the bark?" reveals the dream's reality.

绛台深迥："绛台"指红色的台子，代指大槐安国的宫殿。这里"嵌空中楼郭层城，怎中央有绛台深迥"描述蚁穴中类似宫殿的结构。
Crimson tower deep and remote: "Crimson tower" means a red platform, representing the Huai'an palace. The line "Inlaid in the air, towers and layered walls, how in the center there is a deep and remote crimson tower?" describes the ant-nest structure resembling a palace.

素翼红冠：形容大蚂蚁的外形，代指大槐安国的国王和王后。这里"你看他素翼红冠，长可三寸"指蚁穴中的大蚂蚁。
White wings, red crowns: Describes the appearance of large ants, representing the Huai'an King and Queen. The line "Look at them, white wings, red crowns, about three inches long" refers to the large ants in the nest.

七千二百条德政碑：淳于棼在南柯郡的政绩记录，这里"可惜他们记下有七千二百条德政碑、生祠记，通不见了"感叹梦境的虚幻。
Seven thousand two hundred virtue stele: Records of Chunyu Fen's administration in Nanke. The line "Pity they recorded seven thousand two hundred virtue stele and life shrine records, all gone" laments the dream's illusion.

龟山大猎赋：田子华在梦中写的文章，这里"可惜田秀才一篇《龟山大猎赋》，好文章埋没龟亭"惋惜梦中文章的消逝。
Rhapsody on the Great Hunt at Tortoise Mountain: An essay written by Tian Zihua in the dream. The line "Pity Scholar Tian's 'Rhapsody on the Great Hunt at Tortoise Mountain', good writing buried at Tortoise Pavilion" regrets the loss of the dream writing.

檀萝堑江：梦中檀萝国进攻堑江城的事件，这里"还有檀萝堑江一事可疑"指对梦中战事的疑惑。
Tanluo attacks Trench River: The event in the dream where Tanluo attacked Trench River City. The line "Also the matter of Tanluo attacking Trench River is suspicious" refers to doubt about the dream warfare.

紫檀藤萝：宅东的植物，对应梦中的檀萝国。这里"宅东长堑古溪之上，有紫檀一株，藤萝缠拥"揭示檀萝国的原型。
Red sandalwood and wisteria: Plants east of the house, corresponding to dream Tanluo. The line "East of the house, over the long trench and old stream, there is one red sandalwood tree, embraced by wisteria" reveals the prototype of Tanluo.

赤剥军：指梦中檀萝国的赤驳军，这里"见有大群赤蚁往来，想是此物"指赤蚁对应赤驳军。
Red-stripped army: Refers to the Red-stripped army of dream Tanluo. The line "Saw a large group of red ants coming and going, presumably this is it" means the red ants correspond to the army.

星变流言：梦中大槐安国的星象异常和流言，这里"他国中先有星变流言，国有大恐，都邑迁徙，此其验乎？"指梦境与现实的呼应。
Stellar changes and rumors: The celestial anomalies and rumors in dream Huai'an. The line "In that state, there were first stellar changes and rumors, the state had great fear, the capital moved, is this the verification?" refers to the correspondence between dream and reality.

沧海桑田：比喻世事变化巨大，这里"可知道沧海桑田，也则为漏泄了春光武陵"感叹梦境中的世事变迁。
Seas change into mulberry fields: Metaphor for great changes in the world. The line "Can know seas change into mulberry fields, and also because spring scenery of Wuling was leaked" laments the changes in the dream world.

无遮会：佛教举行的法会，不分贵贱、僧俗均可参加。这里"你何不写下一疏，敬向无遮会上问此情缘？"指通过法会求解梦境疑惑。
Unrestricted assembly: A Buddhist assembly where all, regardless of status, can participate. The line "Why not write a petition, reverently ask about this karmic bond at the Unrestricted assembly?" means seeking answers about the dream through the assembly.

盂兰听经："盂兰"指盂兰盆会，佛教超度亡灵的法会，这里"似盂兰听经，又感动我竹枝残兴"指受法会启发产生的感慨。
Ullambana sutra listening: "Ullambana" is the Ghost Festival assembly for transferring merit to the deceased. The line "Like Ullambana sutra listening, it again moves my bamboo branch remnant spirit" means being inspired by the assembly.

燃指为香：佛教徒以燃指表示虔诚，这里"到期燃指为香，写成一疏"指淳于棼准备虔诚祈祷求解疑惑。
Burn fingers as incense: Buddhists burn fingers to show piety. The line "When the time comes, burn fingers as incense, write a petition" means Chunyu Fen prepares to pray devoutly for answers.

丁丑年相见：梦中父亲约定的相见时间，这里"约丁丑年和我相见""恰今年遇丑逢丁"指现实与梦境时间的巧合。
Meet in the Dingchou year: The meeting time agreed with his father in the dream. The lines "Agreed to meet me in the Dingchou year" and "just right this year encounters Chou and meets Ding" refer to the coincidence between reality and dream time.

顶礼大南无："南无"为佛教用语，意为致敬、归命，"大南无"指对佛陀的尊崇礼拜。这里"顶礼大南无"指僧人向佛陀行礼致敬。
Prostrate to great Namo: "Namo" is Buddhist for "homage"; "great Namo" means reverence to the Buddha. The line "Prostrate to great Namo" means the monk pays respects to the Buddha.

击鼓吹螺：佛教法会中用鼓和螺贝作为法器演奏，这里"击鼓吹螺"描述法会的仪式声响。
Beat drums, blow conches: Drums and conches are used as ritual instruments in Buddhist assemblies. The line "Beat drums, blow conches" describes the ceremonial sounds.

天歌梵放了紧那罗："紧那罗"为佛教天龙八部之一，似人而有角，能歌善舞，这里指天界歌声与梵音如紧那罗演唱般响起。
Heavenly songs and Brahma sounds release Kinnaras: "Kinnaras" are Buddhist deities, human-like with horns, skilled in singing and dancing. Here, it means celestial songs and sacred sounds arise like Kinnara performances.

昼夜灯旛长续命："灯旛"指法会中悬挂的灯和幡，象征续命祈福，这里"昼夜灯旛长续命"指通过灯幡祈求延长寿命。
Day and night lanterns and banners long prolong life: "Lanterns and banners" hung in assemblies symbolize prolonging life and seeking blessings. The line "Day and night lanterns and banners long prolong life" means praying for longevity through them.

欲天多："欲天"指佛教中仍有欲望的天界，这里"人在欲天多，怕煞阎罗"指人在欲界易造业，惧怕阎罗王审判。
Desire heavens are many: "Desire heavens" are Buddhist heavens where desire still exists. The line "Humans in the desire heavens are many, fear Yama greatly" means humans in the desire realm easily create karma and fear King Yama's judgment.

风轮都坏却："风轮"为佛教宇宙观中支撑世界的轮子，这里"次第风轮都坏却"指世界终将毁灭，世事无常。
Wind circles all perish: "Wind circles" are wheels supporting the world in Buddhist cosmology. The line "Sequentially, the wind circles all perish" means the world will eventually be destroyed.The affairs of the world are inconstant.

丝萝：比喻婚姻或亲密关系，这里"弟子有丝萝，曾出守南柯"指淳于棼与公主的婚姻及南柯任职经历。
Ivy and vine: Metaphor for marriage or close bonds. The line "This disciple had ivy and vine, once served as governor of Nanke" refers to Chunyu Fen's marriage and service in Nanke.

光音天：佛教天界之一，众生以光为语，以音为食，这里"光音天里事如何"询问天界情景。
Heaven of Radiance and Sound: A Buddhist heaven where beings communicate by light and feed on sound. The line "How are things in the Heaven of Radiance and Sound?" asks about the heavenly realm.

水陆无边道场：佛教超度水陆众生的大型法会，这里"才做下这坛水陆无边道场"指契玄老僧主持的超度法会。
Boundless land and water altar: A large Buddhist assembly for transferring merit to all land and water beings. The line "Just performed this boundless land and water altar" refers to the assembly presided over by the old monk Qixuan.

七七四十九日：佛教中重要的斋期时长，这里"斋了七七四十九日"指淳于棼虔诚斋戒的时间。
Seven times seven, forty-nine days: An important Buddhist fasting period. The line "Fasted for seven times seven, forty-nine days" means Chunyu Fen's period of devout fasting.

燃指为香：佛教徒以燃指表示极致虔诚，这里"你可便燃指为香，替你铺陈情疏"指淳于棼以燃指表诚心。
Burn fingers as incense: Buddhists burn fingers to show utmost piety. The line "You can then burn fingers as incense, prepare your emotional petition for you" means Chunyu Fen uses finger-burning to show sincerity.

老椿堂：代指父亲，"椿堂"为对父亲的尊称，这里"为他久亡过的老椿堂葬朔边"指淳于棼祈愿亡父生天。
Old hall of the cedar: Represents the father; "hall of the cedar" is a respectful term for father. The line "For his long-deceased old hall of the cedar, buried in the northern frontier" means Chunyu Fen prays for his deceased father's rebirth in heaven.

三摩殿："三摩"即三昧，指禅定境界，这里"显豁在三摩殿"指蝼蚁的情缘在禅定中显现。
Samadhi hall: "Samadhi" means meditative absorption. The line "Manifest clearly in the Samadhi hall" means the karmic connections of the ants are revealed in meditation.

杨枝洒水：佛教以杨枝蘸甘露洒水祈福，这里"我待手洒杨枝有千百转"指老僧洒水净化众生。
Willow sprinkles water: Buddhists use willow branches dipped in sweet dew to sprinkle water for blessings. The line "I intend to hand-sprinkle willow branches a thousand times" means the old monk sprinkles water to purify beings.

雨花天：形容法会中香花如雨般散落，这里"香风台殿雨花天"描绘法会的庄严景象。
Flower rain heavens: Describes fragrant flowers falling like rain during assemblies. The line "Fragrant breeze, terrace hall, flower rain heavens" depicts the assembly's solemn scene.

七宝悬："七宝"指佛教中的七种珍宝，这里"真乃是七宝悬"形容天坛上珍宝璀璨的景象。
Seven treasures suspended: "Seven treasures" are the seven precious substances in Buddhism. The line "Truly it is seven treasures suspended" describes the brilliant scene of treasures on the celestial altar.

孝意坚：指孝心坚定，这里"则要你孝意坚"强调淳于棼对父亲的孝心能助其生天。
Filial intention firm: Means firm filial piety. The line "Only require your filial intention to be firm" emphasizes that Chunyu Fen's filial piety can help his father reach heaven.

道意专：指修道意志专一，这里"则要你道意专"指专一的道心能成就愿望。
Dao intention focused: Means focused intention on cultivating the Dao. The line "Only require your Dao intention to be focused" means a focused mind can achieve wishes.

情边见：指因情感产生的执着见解，这里"则为情边见，生身儿住一边"指淳于棼因情感执着陷入梦境。
View based on emotion: Means a stubborn view arising from emotion. The line "It is because of the view based on emotion, the living self dwells on one side" means Chunyu Fen fell into the dream due to emotional attachment.

騃痴受生："騃痴"指愚痴，"受生"指轮回转生，这里"暗增上騃痴受生边处"指因愚痴在轮回中受生。
Foolish ignorance receiving birth: "Foolish ignorance" means delusion; "receiving birth" means rebirth in samsara. The line "Secretly increasing foolish ignorance, receiving birth in marginal places" means being reborn in unfortunate states due to delusion.

白鹦哥说来：指前文白鹦哥的提示，这里"我分明叫白鹦哥说来，蚁子转身"指老僧曾通过鹦哥暗示梦境真相。
The white parrot spoke of it: Refers to the earlier hint from the white parrot. The line "I clearly told the white parrot to speak of it, the ants turn around" means the old monk once hinted at the dream's truth through the parrot.

半偈暗藏春色：指老僧的诗句暗藏梦境玄机，这里引用诗句点明梦境与现实的关联。
Half a gatha secretly contains spring scenery: Means the old monk's verse lines secretly held the dream's mystery. Here, the quoted verse points out the connection between dream and reality.

忉利天门开："忉利天"为佛教天界之一，这里"忉利天门开"指天界之门打开，众生得以生天。
Trayastrimsa heaven's gate opens: "Trayastrimsa heaven" is a Buddhist heaven. The line "Trayastrimsa heaven's gate opens" means the heavenly gate opens, allowing beings to be reborn there.

檀萝国蝼蚁生天：指梦中檀萝国的蝼蚁在法会中超度生天，这里"檀萝国蝼蚁三万四千户生天"体现佛教普度众生的理念。
Tanluo's ants are reborn in heaven: Means the ants from dream Tanluo are transferred to heaven through the assembly. The line "Thirty-four thousand households of Tanluo's ants are reborn in heaven" embodies the Buddhist ideal of universal salvation.

指轮圆：指燃指的虔诚仪式圆满，这里"打捱着指轮圆"指淳于棼忍受痛苦完成燃指仪式。
Finger wheel complete: Means the pious ritual of finger-burning is completed. The line "Enduring, the finger wheel is complete" means Chunyu Fen bears the pain to complete the ritual.

三十三诸天：佛教中的三十三天界，这里"向三十三诸天位下"指前往天界祈求亲人相见。
Thirty-three heavens: The thirty-three heavens in Buddhism. The line "Towards the positions below the thirty-three heavens" means going to the heavens to pray for reunion with relatives.

焚烧十指连心痛，图得三生见面圆："三生"指过去、现在、未来三世，这里指淳于棼为求与亲人在天界相见，忍受燃指之痛，期盼三世圆满。
Burning ten fingers, heart connected pain, hoping to achieve three lifetimes meeting complete: "Three lifetimes" means past, present, future. Here, it means Chunyu Fen endures the pain of burning fingers to pray for reunion in heaven, hoping for satisfactory across lifetimes.

大槐安国军民蝼蚁五万户口同时生天：指梦中大槐安国的蝼蚁在法会中超度生天，这里体现佛教"众生平等、普度超生"的理念。
Fifty thousand households of soldiers and civilians, ants of Great Huai'an, are simultaneously reborn in heaven: Means the ants from dream Huai'an are transferred to heaven together. This embodies the Buddhist idea of universal equality and salvation.

爷儿不见，又朦胧隔着多娇面："多娇面"指公主的面容，这里淳于棼感叹未见父亲和公主生天，思念之情急切。
Father and son not seen, again dimly separated by the charming face: "Charming face" means the princess's face. Here, Chunyu Fen laments not seeing his father and princess reborn in heaven, his longing intense.

丁丑重相面：呼应前文父亲"丁丑年相见"的约定，这里指父亲在天界与淳于棼相见，应验承诺。
Dingchou year, meet again: Echoes the earlier promise to meet in the Dingchou year. Here, it means the father meets Chunyu Fen in heaven, fulfilling the promise.

坟茔蚁穿：指父亲坟墓被蚂蚁穿穴，暗合大槐安国的蝼蚁缘分，这里"却得这因缘，爷儿巧方便"指因蝼蚁因缘成就父子天界相见。
Grave mound pierced by ants: Means the father's grave was tunneled by ants, coinciding with the ant karma of Huai'an. The line "But obtained this karmic connection, father and son skillfully facilitated" means the ant karma enabled their heavenly meeting.

再休题将权：父亲劝淳于棼放弃从军拜将，避免犯杀戒，这里体现佛教"戒杀"的思想。
Never again mention becoming a general: The father advises Chunyu Fen to abandon military pursuits to avoid breaking the precept against killing. This reflects the Buddhist thought of abstaining from killing.

恩怨都罢了：右相、周弁、田子华与淳于棼放下梦中恩怨，共庆生天，这里暗喻"世事如幻，恩怨皆空"。
Grudges and favors are all finished: The Right Minister, Zhou Bian, Tian Zihua, and Chunyu Fen relinquish their dream enmities and celebrate rebirth in heaven together. This metaphor "worldly affairs are illusory, grudges and favors are empty."

天男天女：佛教中对天界众生的称呼，这里指公主的子女在天界成为天男天女。
Deva males and deva females: Buddhist terms for heavenly beings. Here, it means the princess's children become devas in heaven.

去三千大千，不似小千般："三千大千世界""小千世界"为佛教宇宙观，这里国王感叹天界远超人间小千世界的繁华。
Go to the three thousand great thousand worlds, unlike the small thousand: "Three thousand great thousand worlds" and "small thousand world" are Buddhist cosmology terms. Here, the King marvels that heaven far surpasses the small human world in splendor.

误烟花几年："烟花"指尘世情爱，这里琼英郡主等人感叹尘世情爱终究是虚幻。
Mistaken by fireworks and willows for several years: "Fireworks and willows" means worldly love. Here, Princess Qiongying and others lament that worldly love is ultimately illusory.

云霄隐隐环佩之声："环佩"指古代女子的饰品，行走时发声，这里代指公主，形容其在天界的仙气。
Clouds faintly, sound of jade pendants: "Jade pendants" were ancient women's ornaments that sounded when walking; here it represents the princess, describing her celestial aura in heaven.

金莲云上踹，宝扇月中移："金莲"指仙女的脚步，"宝扇"指天界仪仗，这里描绘公主在天界的尊贵仪态。
Golden lotuses tread on clouds, precious fans move in the moon: "Golden lotuses" means a fairy's footsteps; "precious fans" are celestial regalia. This depicts the princess's honourable demeanor in heaven.

忉利天依旧等你为夫："忉利天"为佛教天界之一，这里公主表示在天界等待淳于棼修行团聚。
Trayastrimsa heaven still awaits you as husband: "Trayastrimsa heaven" is a Buddhist heaven. Here, the princess says she waits in heaven for Chunyu Fen to cultivate and reunite.

嫦娥也就是人间常蚁：将嫦娥比作人间蚂蚁成仙，暗合"众生皆可成佛"的理念，强调蝼蚁与天仙本质无别。
Chang'e is also just a common ant in the human world: Comparing Chang'e to an ant become immortal, echoing the idea that "all beings can attain Buddhahood," emphasizing that ants and celestials are essentially the same.

金钗是槐枝，小盒是槐筴子："槐枝""槐筴子"指槐树的枝和果实，揭示梦中金钗、犀盒的虚幻本质，象征"一切皆空"。
The gold hairpin is a locust branch, the small box is a locust pod: "Locust branch" and "locust pod" are parts of the locust tree, revealing the illusory nature of the dream hairpin and box, symbolizing "all is empty."

人间君臣眷属，蝼蚁何殊：淳于棼醒悟人间的君臣、亲属与蝼蚁并无本质区别，暗喻"众生平等"。
Human rulers, ministers, and families, how do they differ from ants?: Chunyu Fen realizes that human hierarchies and relationships are essentially no different from ants, metaphor "all beings are equal."

马蚁儿倒是你善知识："善知识"指引导修行的人或事物，这里老僧认为蝼蚁的缘分反而点化了淳于棼。
The ant instead is your good spiritual friend: "Good spiritual friend" means a guide on the spiritual path. Here, the old monk says the ant karma actually enlightened Chunyu Fen.

淳于生立地成佛也：指淳于棼破除迷障，顿悟成佛，这里体现佛教"顿悟"的思想。
Chunyu's birth instantly becomes a Buddha: Means Chunyu Fen breaks through delusion and attains immediate enlightenment, reflecting the Buddhist concept of "sudden enlightenment."

普天下梦南柯人似蚁：以"南柯一梦"喻尘世虚幻，以"人似蚁"强调众生平等，点出全剧"人生如幻，世事皆空"的主旨。
All under heaven dream of Nanke, people resemble ants: Uses "Nanke dream" to metaphorize the world's illusion, and "people resemble ants" to emphasize universal equality, highlighting the play's theme: "Life is illusory, worldly affairs are empty."
